links.title: How Do Agentic LLMs Decide to Call Tools? A Tool-Call Vector Shaped by Suppression

evidence: PDF pp.3–4, Section 2/3, Equations 2–5/Table 1: Qwen3-8B non-thinking prompts are behaviorally retained for execution-call/analysis-text contrast. The L24 block-input prediction-position mean difference is fitted on 300 pairs; addition/removal flip all 200 held-out pairs in the primary test. Sufficiency 1.03 and necessity 1.04 are normalized logit-gap effects, not probabilities or a universal theorem.

PDF pp.16–18, Tables 7–10/Appendix A: each of seven models has 300 training and 200 held-out pairs. Qwen3.5-4B and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B use Telecom conversation contexts for discovery; the other five use coding tasks. Vectors and native call tokens are model-specific, so there is no single cross-model vector or seven-way coding-only transfer test.

PDF p.5 Table 2 and p.35 Appendix I.1: web retrieval, SQL and email each have 100 held-out pairs; Qwen3-8B induction/suppression are 100% with norm-matched random direction causing no flips. The direction is fixed but its norm is calibrated from disjoint target-domain training pairs; this is not calibration-free transfer.

PDF pp.5–6 and p.19 Tables 3/12/13: native Qwen3-8B Telecom contexts span 5,385–15,690 tokens and 16–43 tools. Removal suppresses 73 of 199 baseline-positive calls (36.7%); all 200 candidates change from 99.5% to 63.0% call rate. Addition induces 140/200 baseline text turns (70%); random controls are 1.5%/0%. These denominators are explicitly reconciled, not conflicting.

PDF p.20 Appendix C.2/Table 14: 600 non-imperative requests are constructed across four domains and five patterns; up to ten baseline-positive requests per cell are retained in source order. Qwen3-8B evaluates 160, with 93.1% suppression at unit gain and 100% at 1.5 versus random 16.2% at 1.5. This is conditional suppression on selected positive cases, not a success rate over all 600 or all natural requests.

PDF pp.6,20–21 Tables 4/15–17: full scaffold neutral/analysis mean call probabilities are .8486/.0038; format alone gives 1.0000/.9952, and removing format nearly eliminates calls. The Review verb produces 4% calls with write_file but 100% with submit_review, supporting request-tool interaction rather than a context-free analysis-verb ban.

PDF pp.7–8,22–23 Figure 4/Tables 5/19/20: MLPs supply 77.7% of projected formation-window writes, analysis-higher absolute feature mass exceeds execution-higher by 1.99 overall. Semantic labels cover 426 of 640 selected candidates; 214 remain unlabelled but are included in full-feature accounting. Absolute mass ratios and semantic labeling do not by themselves establish a complete causal circuit.

PDF p.8 Section 5.3 versus p.23 Appendix D.5, both visually inspected: the same described five-suppressor intervention has post-call rate 25.5% and projection shift +5.30, but main text says baseline 3.0% and strict recovery 45/200 (22.5%), while appendix says baseline 0/200 and strict recovery 51/200 (25.5%). No explicit cohort reconciliation is supplied for this conflict; neither exact recovery value is adopted as definitive.

PDF p.23 Table 21: after swapping L20–23 MLP outputs, execution call rate is already 93% (from 100%) despite projection gap dropping 60.06→15.78; restoring the vector projection returns 100%. Reverse analysis arm rises 0→95% and returns to 0 after restoration. This is asymmetric mediation evidence, not complete removal of execution behavior by the formation swap.

PDF pp.8–9,24–26 Figure 5/Tables 22–26: L33H29 DLA differs across explicitly distinct 300-pair and 200-pair cohorts (7.91 versus 13.45 delta). MLP34 sweep, patching-subset and feature-evaluation call rates (53.3%,42.5%,41.0%) are separately documented and should not be treated as contradictory. On the same feature cohort, F109925 replacement gives 37%, fixed F91365 control 6.5%, full MLP34 41% and vector addition 100%.

PDF pp.21–22,27–29 Appendix D.3/F.2/Figure 6: single-RMSNorm final Qwen3-8B logit gap is 7.093, while cross-model diagnostics apply final RMSNorm twice to the already normalized final hidden state, yielding nominal 14.030. The paper explicitly discloses this; the latter is not an ordinary final model-output logit gap. Early linear separability at L0/L1 is distinguished from later output-space effects and causal interventions.

PDF p.19 Table 11 and p.26 Appendix E.4: Table 11 reports zero execution call rate after L24 subtraction in the independently refitted neighboring-layer control. E.4 cites that N=300 control but reports 1.78% residual calling, without clarifying a different fitted direction/denominator; 1.78% is not an integer single-pass count out of 300. Its separate 0.99% description of 5/500 is also arithmetically imprecise. Keep these auxiliary estimates unresolved rather than merging protocols.

PDF pp.9,19–20,27,29 Tables 6/12–14/27–30: full-state recovery is 93.5–100%, but native induction ranges 7.5–92% and Granite unit-gain verb-free suppression is 35.5%. Kcorrupt/Kclean remains above one across models. Reported transfer regularities coexist with substantial model-specific variation.

PDF pp.30–32 Tables 31/32 and Figures 7/8: Qwen3-8B sparse core replay 1.0000 sufficiency is close to random-core .9768, and EAP-IG needs 100,000 edges for .809 normalized faithfulness. Authors correctly avoid treating sparse-core replay as proof of a unique privileged route; the dense feature graph is an illustrative local attribution view.

PDF p.10 Limitations and pp.35–36 Appendix I: no tests of tool choice, arguments or task completion; implicit-request transfer does not establish identical formation. Code https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling and Hugging Face dataset/checkpoint links are supplied, with about 800 B200 GPU-hours for Transcoder training and a claimed 96GB-GPU reproduction path. Those linked assets were not downloaded, verified or executed in this review.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant and comparatively rich mechanistic study: local addition/subtraction, random directions, scaffold ablations, request-tool crossover, feature mediation and seven-model transfer go beyond correlational probing. The supported conclusion is a reusable model-specific intervention direction for a first-token call marker. Behaviorally screened prompts and norm-calibrated cross-domain tests do not establish an unconditional universal switch, identical formation on implicit requests, or improved downstream task success. The main-text versus appendix suppressor-ablation baseline/strict-recovery conflict remains unresolved; diagnostic double-normalization and an ambiguous neighboring-control result require careful separation. These reporting limitations reduce evidence confidence without making the complete supplied PDF a missing-source case.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: A relevant and comparatively rich mechanistic study: local addition/subtraction, random directions, scaffold ablations, request-tool crossover, feature mediation and seven-model transfer go beyond correlational probing. The supported conclusion is a reusable model-specific intervention direction for a first-token call marker. Behaviorally screened prompts and norm-calibrated cross-domain tests do not establish an unconditional universal switch, identical formation on implicit requests, or improved downstream task success. The main-text versus appendix suppressor-ablation baseline/strict-recovery conflict remains unresolved; diagnostic double-normalization and an ambiguous neighboring-control result require careful separation. These reporting limitations reduce evidence confidence without making the complete supplied PDF a missing-source case.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這是高度相關且證據面較豐富的機制研究：局部加減向量、隨機方向、提示結構消融、請求與工具交叉、中介介入及七模型遷移，超越單純相關探測。較穩健的結論是，各模型存在可重用的首詞元工具呼叫介入方向。經行為篩選的提示與跨領域長度校準，不能證明無條件通用開關、隱含請求具有完全相同的形成機制，或下游任務成功率提升。正文及附錄對抑制特徵消融的基線／嚴格復原率有未解衝突，診斷雙重正規化與鄰層控制結果的指涉亦應分開。這些論文報告限制降低證據信心，但不代表已取得的完整 PDF 有缺件。
llm_evaluation.scope_assessment: In scope: causal/mechanistic analysis of language-agent tool initiation and activation steering, not a domain-only application.

primary_link.title: How Do Agentic LLMs Decide to Call Tools? A Tool-Call Vector Shaped by Suppression

papers.summary: Tool calling, invoking external tools on demand, is central to agentic LLMs, yet the mechanism that decides whether a model calls a tool or responds directly remains poorly understood. Agentic prompts are long and heavily scaffolded, combining role instructions, tool schemas, format templates, and the user's request across hundreds of tokens, creating a noisy, highly entangled context in which no single controllable variable for mechanistic analysis is obvious. To obtain such a variable, we propose a method that converts complex agentic prompts into minimal contrastive pairs in which a single request verb determines the tool-call decision: replacing an execution-verb (e.g., \textit{write}) with an analysis-verb (e.g., \textit{discuss}) reliably flips the decision, suggesting it is mediated by a compact internal state. We construct 500 such paired prompts across Python, Java, and C++ (300 for mechanistic analysis, 200 held out for evaluation). We trace the decision to a vector, $\mu_\Delta$, that is both causally necessary and sufficient and generalizes beyond the discovery prompts to native multi-turn $\tau^2$-Bench trajectories and verb-free requests. Behavioral ablations show that the scaffold establishes a tool-call prior; Transcoder decomposition then reveals that analysis verbs suppress this prior through features signaling that tool use is unnecessary, whereas execution verbs largely leave it intact. Downstream scaffold-reading attention heads and MLP features read out the resulting state, and the same mechanism recurs across seven models from the Qwen, Mistral, and Granite families. Our code is available at https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling.
papers.summary_en: A residual vector fitted from verb-swapped prompts can flip Qwen3-8B's first tool-call token. Scaffold ablations and feature interventions support a suppression-based account, with tests across seven models and native dialogues. Yet native Qwen3-8B calls are suppressed only 36.7% at unit gain; task success is untested and cross-domain transfer calibrates vector norm. Main-text and appendix suppressor-ablation rates conflict. All 36 pages, figures and tables were read; linked code and checkpoints were not rerun.
papers.summary_zh:
一句請求中的動詞，可能改變代理選擇直接回答還是呼叫工具。這篇研究先篩出只替換動詞就能翻轉首個輸出詞元的成對提示，主要以 Qwen3-8B 的三百組資料估計中間層活化差向量，再用二百組保留資料測試。加上或減去此向量，可在受控提示中完全翻轉工具呼叫標記。

分析指出，工具格式範本先建立呼叫傾向，要求討論、分析的語意則透過多層 MLP 特徵壓低傾向；後段注意力與 MLP 再將狀態轉成輸出。它不是單一神經元開關，也不是跨模型共用同一組向量。研究涵蓋七個模型，並測試新工具、長對話及沒有明示動作動詞的請求。在原生 τ²-Bench 對話中，Qwen3-8B 的單位強度介入抑制 36.7% 既有呼叫，誘發 70% 原本直接回答的回合，效果遠非一律百分之百。

重要限制是只判斷首詞元，沒有驗證工具選擇、參數或任務完成；跨領域結果還校準了向量長度。正文與附錄對五項抑制特徵消融的起始呼叫率及嚴格復原率存在矛盾，不能合併引用。三十六頁、八圖與三十三表已讀，程式、資料與 Transcoder 連結有列出但未重跑。其價值在可介入的機制線索，尚不能當作通用可靠性或安全控制。

papers.title_zh: 代理式大型語言模型如何決定呼叫工具？由抑制機制塑造的工具呼叫向量

links.title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis

evidence: PDF pp.4–5, Section 3 and Figure 2: Proposer preserves applicability conditions while varying context, Builder constructs executable scenarios and obtains five valid scenarios per skill, and Verifier uses paired trajectories with and without the skill; keep iff empirical score is positive.

PDF p.6, Table 2 and implementation details: three executors, same 100 source tasks, frozen libraries; evaluation uses 140 ALFWorld and 500 WebShop tasks. Qwen3.5-27B WebShop SR is 32.2% No Skill versus 45.0% SkillSandbox, a derived 12.8 percentage-point gain; mean steps 8.0 versus 7.2. ACE reaches 37.4%, so gain over that stronger baseline is 7.6 points, not 12.8.

PDF pp.7–8, Section 5.1/Figure 3: same Verifier and five-scenario/execution/task budget compares synthesized, source and random evidence. Gemini-labelled executor ALFWorld SR is 60.0% synthesized versus 50.7% source and 44.3% random; WebShop is 36.2% versus 33.0% and 31.6%.

PDF p.8, Table 3: Gemini 3.1 Flash-labelled Proposer gives WebShop precision/recall/F1/specificity 96.0/82.8/88.9/94.4%, versus ALFWorld 39.1/81.8/52.9/60.0%. Section 4.1 says Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is used for execution, synthesis and verification; Tables 1/3/6 use Flash. This discrepancy is retained rather than silently normalized.

PDF pp.3 and 15: Figure 1 reports mean and one-standard-deviation bands from three repeats of one fixed 500-task stream, based on self-cited skill IDs. This uncertainty evidence does not apply to the main results in Table 2, and cited use is not causal verification of actual skill reliance.

PDF pp.14–15, Appendices A/B: ReasoningBank excludes MaTTS, MemP uses Script/Vanilla, SkillOS uses training-free base; ACE receives the whole playbook, unlike common top-three retrieval. Alignment uses identical observations, temporally ordered one-to-one pairs and discount 0<gamma<1, but a numeric gamma and empty-alignment handling are not supplied.

PDF pp.9 and 16–18, Figures 4–6/Tables 5–7: success and action efficiency can disagree; WebShop both-success skill pairs take extra actions. Rejected-skill cases illustrate overgeneralized appliance ordering and needless two-section verification. Synthesis type shares overlap and must not be summed as mutually exclusive categories.

PDF pp.17–18, Table 7: k=3 is selected after reporting the highest held-out SR (84/140 and 181/500). A distinct tuning/validation split is not described, so possible held-out selection bias is a limitation, not proven data leakage.

PDF p.2 promises omission-of-executability/efficiency ablations and larger gains on unseen task types. Full reading of pp.1–22, all six figures and seven tables found no corresponding displayed component-ablation or held-out-task-type results; these claims are not credited.

PDF pp.19–22, Appendix F: execution and distillation templates are included, but Proposer prompts are summaries and retry/format-repair messages are omitted. The first-page CODE hyperlink is https://anonymous.4open.science/r/skillsandbox-647C/; its target was not inspected or executed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong fit for agent skill and memory curation, with an actionable distinction between a skill-relevant test and a merely similar task. Frozen-library held-out tests and a matched verification-rollout comparison support the scenario-synthesis contribution. However, ALFWorld verdict precision is only 39.1% for the Gemini-labelled row; main tables lack uncertainty and do not include construction cost. Restricted baseline variants, Flash versus Flash-Lite labels, unspecified discount settings and introductory ablation/unseen-task claims without displayed results limit confidence. Evidence supports this bounded filtering approach, not universal skill verification, model independence or net compute savings.

Frozen-library held-out tests and a matched verification-rollout comparison support the scenario-synthesis contribution. However, ALFWorld verdict precision is only 39.1% for the Gemini-labelled row; main tables lack uncertainty and do not include construction cost. Restricted baseline variants, Flash versus Flash-Lite labels, unspecified discount settings and introductory ablation/unseen-task claims without displayed results limit confidence. Evidence supports this bounded filtering approach, not universal skill verification, model independence or net compute savings.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這篇與代理技能及記憶管理高度相關，清楚區分真正會觸發技能的測試與僅語意相似的任務。凍結技能庫的保留測試，以及驗證回合預算相同的比較，支持情境合成的貢獻。然而 Gemini 標籤列在 ALFWorld 的技能判決精確率只有 39.1%；主要結果缺乏不確定性，亦未計入建構成本。基線受限版本、Flash 與 Flash-Lite 名稱差異、未指定折扣，以及導論宣稱卻未展示的消融與未見任務結果，皆限制可信度。證據支持特定環境內的篩選方法，不支持通用技能保證、模型能力無關性或整體運算節省。
llm_evaluation.scope_assessment: In scope: reusable textual skill verification for language agents operating in text-action environments; ALFWorld is a language-agent benchmark, not a claim of physical robotics performance.

primary_link.title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis

papers.summary: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.
papers.summary_en: SkillSandbox creates new executable scenarios for each skill, then compares an agent with and without it before library admission. Qwen3.5-27B improves WebShop success from 32.2% to 45.0%; downstream steps exclude synthesis costs. Read the matched-budget comparison and failure cases, but note weak ALFWorld verdict precision, missing uncertainty, model-label inconsistencies and unshown introductory ablation claims. All 22 pages were read; the linked code was not inspected and results were not reproduced.
papers.summary_zh:
代理把一次成功經驗存成技能，可能連當時偶然有效的做法也一起記住。SkillSandbox 針對每項技能主動建立新測試：提案者保留技能適用條件、改動原任務細節，建構器生成可執行情境，再比較同一代理使用與不使用技能的軌跡。評分兼顧動作可執行性、成功結果與剩餘步數，只有正分技能進入資料庫。

作者以相同的一百項來源任務建立各方法的技能庫，固定後測試 ALFWorld 一百四十題及 WebShop 五百題。Qwen3.5-27B 在 WebShop 的成功率由無技能的 32.2% 升至 45.0%，平均步數由 8.0 降至 7.2；這些步數只涵蓋下游作答，不能當成合成與驗證也更省。固定驗證回合預算的比較支持合成情境，但技能判定品質依環境差很多，不能把保留判決當成安全或可移轉保證。

閱讀時宜先看成對比較和錯誤案例，再檢查代價與基線設定。主要結果沒有信賴區間，部分基線採簡化版本；表格中的 Gemini 名稱與實作段落不一致，折扣參數也未給定。導論另外宣稱的逐項判準消融與未見任務類型結果，現有正文及附錄未展示。完整二十二頁與圖表已讀，程式連結未另行驗證；目前證據支持技能庫篩選方法，尚不足以外推到開放網頁、真實機器人或任意模型。

links.title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles

evidence: PDF pp.3–6, Equations 2–12 and Algorithm 1: task-type matching retrieves top-K skills; pre-retirement removes skills with low base-policy success; successful trajectories involving surviving skills seed SFT. Runtime tracks trial/active/stable/retired states and uses a distinct teacher family for mutation.

PDF pp.5–6 and p.16 Table 6: K=6 retrieved skills all receive the same binary episode reward; cumulative success/usage drives lifecycle. Default retirement/demotion/stability thresholds are .4/.5/.7, with at most 5 mutations and 3 ordinary retirements per 10 training steps.

PDF pp.7–8 Table 2/Section 5.2: SkillForge reports ALFWorld 92.4 and WebShop 78.4 success versus SkillRL 89.9/72.7. WebShop improvement is 5.7 percentage points or about 7.84% relative, not 7.8 percentage points.

PDF p.7 Table 2 and p.15 Appendix B: ALFWorld subtask counts are 24,15,27,26,21,17 and SkillForge rates 98.2,86.6,89.8,93.7,95.6,88.4. Their sample-weighted mean is 92.5153846%, whereas All is 92.4%; the discrepancy exceeds ordinary one-decimal rounding allowance. SkillRL recomputes to 89.8738462%, compatible with 89.9. Values were checked in rendered pages; raw outputs are unavailable to resolve the difference.

PDF p.8 Table 3: removing pre-retirement lowers success by 1.7/3.5/1.2 points, retirement by 1.0/2.5/.8 and mutation by .6/1.6/.5 across ALFWorld/WebShop/QA. These component ablations support contribution but do not isolate individual-skill causal harm.

PDF pp.15–17 Tables 5–7: one Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct policy, Kimi-K2.5 teacher, 200 steps, learning rate 1e-6, 64 H200 GPUs; reported training cost totals 7,296 GPU-hours across three environments plus pre-retirement/evaluation. ALFWorld retirement/cap sweeps stay within 1.4 points of default.

PDF pp.19–20 Appendix D/Table 10: 51,713 QA samples, two in-domain and five out-of-domain datasets; other methods' cells are imported from source papers. Displayed rates recompute to SkillForge 48.6529 and SkillRL 46.8243, compatible with 48.7/46.8, but common weighting does not establish identical original evaluation conditions.

PDF pp.5,17–20 Tables 1/8/9 and Figures 3–7: 5,852 records comprise 1,013 SFT trajectories, 4,521 per-skill snapshots and 318 retirement events aggregated over several runs. They are not 5,852 independent tasks/skills. The main run has 84 retirements; 318 aggregate events are explicitly explained, not a count contradiction.

PDF pp.20–21 Appendix E.2/Figure 7: two annotators initially achieve Cohen kappa .5 before discussion; 237/318 events are labeled overly rigid ordering, and 57.2% of retired skills reportedly reached stable state earlier. Annotation and declining conditional success support a descriptive failure taxonomy, not counterfactual proof that each skill caused failure.

PDF pp.6,21–23: Algorithm 1 caps only by removing active skills and can stop above cap if none remain; trial children are inserted into the non-retired library. Therefore a universal hard-size guarantee and a claim that trial gating prevents any influence before active status are not established by the presented algorithm. Appendix H also says the no-mutation library values refer to initial |S0|, while Table 3 labels them final counts.

PDF p.24 Appendix H: every number averages five decoding-seed evaluations of the best validation checkpoint; reported SDs are .5/.4/.3 points. One-sample t-tests compare against fixed SkillRL point estimates; the Welch alternative assumes baseline variance equal to SkillForge's rather than measuring it. This does not establish independently trained-run variance or matched-baseline uncertainty.

PDF pp.17–19 describes a CC-BY-4.0 SkillFurnace release with three JSON files and a schema. All 24 pages, references, appendices A–H, ten tables and seven figures were read; neither text nor PDF URI annotations contained a direct SkillForge/SkillFurnace download link. No author code, external dataset or experiment was retrieved or executed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant skill-memory/RL contribution with useful lifecycle controls, three-environment ablations, threshold sensitivity and failure-taxonomy analysis. The scientific case is promising but not definitive: co-retrieved skills share reward, cumulative fitness is not a causal estimate of skill harm, baseline QA scores come from separate papers, and five stochastic evaluations of a selected checkpoint do not establish training-seed robustness. The one-sample significance analysis ignores observed baseline uncertainty; the subsequent Welch calculation assumes rather than measures it. A small ALFWorld weighted-aggregate discrepancy and lifecycle-description ambiguities require explicit qualification. The complete PDF is available; these are reporting and evidential limitations, not missing-source holds. Claimed dataset availability remains unverified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: A highly relevant skill-memory/RL contribution with useful lifecycle controls, three-environment ablations, threshold sensitivity and failure-taxonomy analysis. The scientific case is promising but not definitive: co-retrieved skills share reward, cumulative fitness is not a causal estimate of skill harm, baseline QA scores come from separate papers, and five stochastic evaluations of a selected checkpoint do not establish training-seed robustness. The one-sample significance analysis ignores observed baseline uncertainty; the subsequent Welch calculation assumes rather than measures it. A small ALFWorld weighted-aggregate discrepancy and lifecycle-description ambiguities require explicit qualification. The complete PDF is available; these are reporting and evidential limitations, not missing-source holds. Claimed dataset availability remains unverified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這項研究與技能記憶及代理強化學習高度相關，生命週期控制、三環境消融、閾值敏感度與失敗分類都有參考價值，但證據仍需校準：共取技能共享回合獎勵，累積適應度不能當作技能造成傷害的因果估計；問答基線來自不同論文，選定模型的五次隨機評估也不能證明訓練種子穩健性。單樣本顯著性檢定未納入實測基線變異，後續 Welch 計算使用假設變異。ALFWorld 加權總分有小幅落差，部分生命週期描述與偽碼也需釐清。PDF 全文完整，這些屬論文報告與證據限制，不是來源缺件；資料集發布仍未獨立驗證。
llm_evaluation.scope_assessment: In scope: language-agent skill memory and reinforcement-learning methodology evaluated across interactive text environments and QA; not pure robotics or a domain-only application.

primary_link.title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles

papers.summary: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.
papers.summary_en: SkillForge jointly trains a 7B agent and manages skills through trial, active, stable and retired states, with teacher-written mutations. Reported WebShop success rises from 72.7% to 78.4%; ablations support filtering and lifecycle management. Shared episode rewards cannot isolate individual skill effects, five evaluation seeds do not establish training robustness, and imported QA baselines weaken comparability. A small ALFWorld aggregation discrepancy remains. All 24 pages and figures were read; the claimed dataset release was not verified.
papers.summary_zh:
代理累積的技能不一定越多越好：原本有用的操作指引，也可能在模型進步後變成干擾。SkillForge 將技能分成試用、活躍、穩定與退役四種狀態，先用基礎模型的互動結果篩除低適用技能，再做監督微調；強化學習期間持續按成功率淘汰、升降級，並請外部教師模型改寫表現普通的技能。

研究使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和搜尋增強問答測試。作者報告成功率分別為 92.4%、78.4% 與 48.7%，其中 WebShop 相較 SkillRL 提升 5.7 個百分點，約為 7.8% 相對增幅。消融支持預先篩選與動態管理都有作用，另提供涵蓋軌跡、技能快照與退役事件的 5,852 筆資料描述。

不過，每回合六項技能共用同一獎勵，無法辨認個別技能的因果貢獻；五次評估重抽樣也不代表五次獨立訓練。問答基線取自不同論文，統計檢定把基線當固定值。ALFWorld 的分項加權重算約為 92.52%，與宣稱的 92.4% 有小幅但超出表格四捨五入的落差。全文二十四頁與全部圖表已讀，未見本文資料集的直接下載連結，亦未重跑實驗。適合借鏡技能管理設計，但精確優勢、可重現性與跨模型效果仍需保留。

primary_link.title: RewardWeaver: Long-Horizon Interactive Learning for Language Agents via Self-Evolving Reward Adaptation

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in domains where task outcomes can be reliably evaluated, but long-horizon interaction remains challenging due to sparse terminal feedback and difficult credit assignment. Process rewards provide denser supervision, yet the capabilities most relevant for training can change as the policy evolves: a behavior that is easy to evaluate or frequently deficient need not be the bottleneck currently limiting task success. We introduce RewardWeaver, a self-evolving reward adaptation framework for language agents in long-horizon interaction. RewardWeaver maintains a validated capability space in which the semantics of admitted Rubrics remain fixed, and closes the loop between policy optimization, task evaluation, failure attribution, and reward adaptation. After each training stage, it performs outcome-grounded backward attribution on low-outcome trajectories, aggregates recurrent and policy-controlled capability bottlenecks, and dynamically selects the corresponding process rewards for the next stage. Recurrent failures not covered by the existing capability space trigger a separate, controlled expansion procedure. We evaluate REWARDWEAVER on SOTOPIA, Amazon?HistoryPrice, and a newly constructed Sales Benchmark. Across social interaction, bilateral bargaining, and domain-specific sales, REWARDWEAVER establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. Ablations further demonstrate the importance of dynamic reward allocation, failure-grounded attribution, and stable semantics for admitted capabilities.
papers.summary_en: RewardWeaver changes which process rewards a dialogue agent optimizes while freezing admitted rubric meanings. Failure-grounded selection beats matched alternatives on several benchmarks, but Sales wins six of eight metrics. Read the ablations before accepting broad SOTA claims: literature partners differ, Sales tests share scenario families with training, and uncertainty and implementation details are limited. All 23 pages and figures were reviewed; experiments and promised release materials were not independently verified.
papers.summary_zh:
多輪對話代理即使知道最後失敗，也未必知道下一階段應改善什麼。RewardWeaver 把這個問題拆成兩層：內層用強化學習更新策略，外層從低成果對話找出反覆出現、且由代理自身控制的能力缺口，再挑選相應的過程獎勵。已接納的評分規則與評分器維持固定；新能力須另外驗證，延後到後續階段使用，避免訓練目標隨意漂移。

作者在社交互動、議價與合成銷售情境評估。SOTOPIA-Hard 自我對弈中，相同設定的 AMPO 目標／整體分數為 7.67／3.94，本方法為 7.90／4.38；隨機換規則與只按缺陷頻率選擇的消融較弱，支持有根據的動態選擇。銷售基準則只在八項指標中的六項最佳，並非全面勝出。

閱讀時要留意比較邊界：舊文獻的對手與本次實驗不同，不能把整張表視為完全公平的排行榜。銷售測試與訓練共享情境家族與人物設定庫，僅衡量家族內新任務；論文未給多種隨機種子的變異、信賴區間或完整訓練與評分器驗收參數。完整二十三頁及附錄已核對，但未重現實驗，也未查證承諾發布的資料與程式。它值得作為獎勵設計方法閱讀，成果仍受模型評分器、任務範圍與重現資訊限制。

links.title: Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents

evidence: PDF pp.3–4, Section III and Tables II/III: 24 frozen tasks from 312 eligible of 400 candidates, 16 domain combinations; six models and two independent samples per cell plus a 480-trial Claude prompt arm total 1,920 trials. Non-triggered faults are excluded; 384+379+273+284+374=1,694 analysed trials. Table III calls repetitions seeds, but the prose explicitly says provider sampling is unseeded.

PDF p.3, Sections III-B/C: corruption changes returned values while preserving underlying state; two empty-result exceptions change type. Missing-tool/schema faults fire only on targeted calls (71%/74%); timeout/corruption at 99%/97%. Median injection timing differs (2 versus 5), so fault contrasts are not perfectly matched interventions.

PDF p.4, Section III-E, Equations 1–3: recovery requires exact agreement across public fields with the same model/task clean reference, not benchmark ground truth. Clean-run agreement is 63.3% pooled, so recovery does not measure absolute task accuracy.

PDF p.4, Section III-F: one author coded 100 earlier-scoring-pass examples; 92 were jointly coded. Binary detection agreement is 85.9%, kappa 0.69; original three-way kappa 0.47. Detection means treating the result as a problem in language, not inferred internal awareness.

PDF p.5, Table IV and Section IV-A: author reports loud detection 91.3% (936 trials, task-clustered 95% CI 88.3–94.1), quiet 58.8% (374, 45.7–71.2), no-fault target-success baseline 26.8% (306, 17.8–36.5). These are Table/text-specific values and are disputed by Figure 1.

PDF p.5, visually inspected Figure 1: left panel instead prints no-fault 25% n=320, quiet 53% n=308, loud 86% n=795; right panel none/acknowledged/rationalized is loud 14/52/34, quiet 47/34/19, no-fault 75/15/10. The nearby prose says unproblematic pass-through 4% loud and 39% quiet. The PDF supplies no reconciliation; no explanation is invented.

PDF pp.5–7, Figure 2/Table V: 450 matched pairs give reasoning-minus-instruct detection -9.3 points, replanning +10.4 and recovery -2.4 (95% CI -9.3 to +4.5; p=.512). Qwen provides the clearest family effect; Claude detection loses significance in an alternative covariate specification, and DeepSeek-R1 sometimes emits tool syntax as non-executable text.

PDF pp.6–7, Figure 3/Table VI: clean state agreement 63.3%, missing tool 39.9%, timeout 59.6%, schema drift 59.2%, corruption 60.4%. Only missing tool differs in the primary clustered model; schema drift does differ after adding model (pHolm=.024), so no-harm or equivalence claims are unjustified.

PDF pp.6–8: same-tool repetition means at least three consecutive calls, possibly changed arguments (12.5–22.2% by fault); strictly identical repetition is only 0.8–1.8%. Fifteen-call cap and one-family prompt-arm null results limit conclusions.

PDF pp.2 and 8: authors state harness, frozen suite, trajectories and scored data are released at https://github.com/obadaKraishan/brittle-agents. The repository was not fetched or executed; availability, source/data-version correspondence and exact-model reproducibility remain unverified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant and useful evaluation design that avoids conflating noticing, taking a different action and returning to a reference state. Task-clustered inference, repeated clean runs and explicit limitations are substantive strengths. However, Figure 1 conflicts materially with Table IV and the text on central detection rates, denominators and response categories; the exact headline estimates cannot be independently settled from this PDF. Recovery is model-relative state agreement, not correct task completion, and nonsignificant recovery differences are not equivalence. Limited task/model coverage, conditional fault firing and textual detection further constrain interpretation. The complete source is readable, but its inconsistent quantitative evidence warrants a lower evidence score and an explicit caveat.

primary_link.title: Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents

papers.summary: Tool-using agents are usually scored on whether they finish a task while the tools work. Deployments are less forgiving: services time out, endpoints disappear, parameter names change, and results come back well formed but wrong. Prior work has shown that language models over-trust tool outputs that fail silently; we ask how that over-trust plays out across the stages of failure handling in multi-turn agents. Wrapping the executable environments of an established function-calling benchmark in a fault-injection layer, we inject one of four typed faults at a controlled point in the trajectory and record whether the agent notices, changes plan, recovers the task, or repeats itself. Six models from three families, half of them reasoning variants, ran 1,920 trials over 24 multi-step tasks. Agents treat a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool returns an explicit error, but in 58.8% of trials when it returns a plausible wrong value, against a 26.8% rate of reporting problems when nothing was wrong. Reasoning models are not better placed: paired against instruct siblings, they notice less (-9.3 points, p < .001) and change plan more (+10.4 points, p < .001), and recovery is unchanged (p = .512). Because agents are stochastic, two fault-free runs of the same task end in the same state only 63.3% of the time; against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery (39.9%), while timeouts, schema drift, and corruption stay within run-to-run variation. After a fault, agents return to the same tool three or more times in a row in up to 22.2% of trials, though strictly identical repeats are rare. A prompt line asking the agent to check each result did not move detection. Agents respond to the error channel rather than to the content of what a tool returns, so failures that stay inside the expected format pass through.
papers.summary_en: This study separates fault detection, replanning, end-state recovery and repetition in tool agents. Table IV reports 91.3% detection for explicit errors versus 58.8% for silent corruption, but Figure 1 shows different rates and sample counts. Recovery matches a model's own clean-run state, not ground-truth task success. Task-clustered analyses are useful, yet 24 tasks, three model pairs and textual detection limit transfer. All eight pages were read; the numerical conflict remains and data were not recomputed.
papers.summary_zh:
工具沒有報錯，不代表回傳內容可信。這篇研究在 BFCL 的可執行多輪環境注入逾時、工具缺失、參數變動與格式正常但內容錯誤的回傳，分開量測代理是否表達懷疑、是否改變下一步、是否回到正常執行的終態，以及是否重複呼叫。六個模型在二十四項任務執行一千九百二十次，扣除未觸發故障的試驗後分析一千六百九十四次。

表四與正文報告，明顯錯誤的偵測率為 91.3%，靜默錯誤為 58.8%；但同頁圖一卻標成 86% 與 53%，樣本數也不同，因此精確比例仍有未解矛盾，不能把圖表說成相互驗證。研究較有價值的是拆開失敗處理階段：推理版本較常改變行動，不代表更常察覺錯誤；其復原差異未達顯著，也不是證明兩者等效。

尤其要注意，這裡的復原指與同模型一次無故障執行的環境終態一致，並非達成標準答案。錯誤資訊可能被帶進回覆，卻不改變環境狀態。研究提供任務分群統計與人工標註一致性檢查，但只有三組模型、單一基準家族、十五次工具呼叫上限，且偵測依文字表達判定。八頁正文和全部圖表已核對，連結資料未重算；適合借鏡其測試設計，對精確數值、模型優劣及部署安全結論則需保留。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong topic fit and useful study of trainable advice during tool-using episodes. The same-initialization prompted critic is a relevant baseline, and fixed4B critics transfer beyond their training partner. The main attached improvement is25.31 percentage points as reported from unrounded results, not25.31 percent relative gain or proof a4B system dominates a frontier model generally. The result includes an extra advisor and prompt-guided consultation. Self-call is not a trained optimal stopping policy: the actor is frozen and the supplied instructions encourage, or for ALFWorld require, at least one review. Small OOD sets and seed-level SEM warrant caution, and the attached critic causes a clear mean drop on larger-model DeepDive. Selected advice-type plots are descriptive, not causal estimates. The training objective also permits solution copying and requires expensive branch restoration. The26-page PDF supplies sufficient material for a bounded full review; absence of externally verified code/weights restricts reproduction rather than making all content unassessable.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 主題高度相關，對工具使用過程中可訓練的文字建議提供有用實證。同初始模型的提示顧問是合理對照，固定四十億顧問也能轉移至其他執行模型。附段落主要增益依作者未四捨五入結果為二十五點三一個百分點，不是相對增加百分之二十五點三一，更不代表四十億系統普遍勝過前沿模型；系統另加顧問及求助提示。主動呼叫不是訓練出的最優停止策略：執行模型固定，提示鼓勵諮詢，ALFWorld 甚至要求至少一次。外域題少且標準誤按種子計算，須審慎解讀；附段落顧問對較大模型的 DeepDive 平均表現明顯下降。依建議類型選出的軌跡分析是描述性而非因果估計。訓練目標仍可能鼓勵直接提供答案，且分支環境還原昂貴。二十六頁全文足以做有界評估，外部程式與權重未驗證限制的是重現，並非所有內容都不可判讀。

primary_link.title: Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes

papers.summary: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie, a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic's feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B's success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including $\tau^3$ and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.
papers.summary_en: Caddie trains a frozen-agent advisor from the success of branched continuations, without reference critiques. A 4B advisor raises MuSiQue attached success from 21.56% to 46.88% and transfers to several models and tasks. Transfer is uneven: one advisor lowers larger-model DeepDive success. Self-calling is prompt-guided, selected feedback analyses are noncausal, and eight rollout seeds are not training replicas. State restoration and many continuations are costly; matched-compute superiority is untested.
papers.summary_zh:
代理走到一半卡住時，小模型能否提供比強模型臨時建議更有用的指引？Caddie 固定執行任務的模型，在同一中途狀態產生多份文字建議，讓代理分別繼續操作，再用最終成敗訓練顧問。它不需逐步對錯標籤或示範評語，但格式不合格另有懲罰。推論時代理可呼叫顧問，最多三次；顧問只提供文字，環境操作仍由原代理執行。

以 Qwen3 四十億參數顧問搭配同規模代理，兩百道 MuSiQue 附段落題的成功率從百分之二十一點五六升至四十六點八八，作者報告增加二十五點三一個百分點。其他代理與客服、網頁搜尋任務也有轉移，但幅度不一；維基版顧問在較大代理的 DeepDive 僅小幅改善，附段落版反而由四十八點八三降到四十四點五三。

這篇的價值是把建議當作會改變後續行為的介入，而非只判斷某一步是否正確。不過「自行求助」受到提示詞鼓勵甚至要求至少一次，不能當成額外學出的最佳求助策略。八次測試抽樣不是八次獨立訓練，小型外域測試的標準誤也採不同計算方式。訓練需要大量分支續跑及還原環境，尚無同運算預算的驗證器比較；在可一次解完的問題上，顧問更可能直接給答案，轉移性與實際成本仍需評估。

primary_link.title: CERO: Where and When to Allocate Rollouts for RL Post-Training

papers.summary: Adaptive rollout methods for group-relative reinforcement learning typically allocate a fixed per-update budget across prompts. We instead study how to coordinate a finite rollout budget over the entire training horizon. We formulate this problem using a concave surrogate utility of cumulative prompt exposure and introduce CERO, an online primal dual scheduler for prompt admission and budget pacing. In our experiments, each admitted prompt receives a fixed-size response group. CERO instead adapts which prompts are selected, how often they are revisited across rounds, and how many groups are generated in each round. A compact Fenchel representation linearizes the dependence on cumulative exposure, while projected online gradient descent updates prompt-specific supporting slopes and a shared budget price using reward-variation feedback and budget deviations. We establish pathwise guarantees for the surrogate allocation objective against fixed-rate and same-path time-varying benchmarks, with explicit terms for proxy discrepancy and rate variation. Under matched training-response budgets, CERO attains the highest avg@16 macro-average on each of three backbones across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Mechanistic analyses link CERO's prompt choices to within-group reward contrast, while multi-seed ablations show gains from adaptive pacing over both uniform and preset spending schedules.
papers.summary_en: CERO coordinates prompt admission and training-wide budget pacing while keeping eight responses per admitted prompt. Across three backbones it improves avg@16 macro scores at matched response counts; three-seed ablations support adaptive pacing. Guarantees concern a concave surrogate on a fixed rate path, not learning optimality. The variance proxy is miscalibrated, pass@16 does not always lead, and response budgets do not match token or update counts. Single-run timing shows comparable cost.
papers.summary_zh:
強化學習後訓練的生成預算有限，除了挑選哪些題目，還要決定何時多花、何時保留。CERO 把整段訓練視為共享預算的分配問題，用遞減效益描述反覆練習同題的價值，再以每題的支持斜率與共同預算價格調整選題及各輪支出。實驗中每次選中的題目固定生成八份回答，改變的是入選次數與每輪選幾題，並非動態放大單題群組。

三個語言模型皆以二十五萬六千份訓練回答，在五個數學基準比較。CERO 的每題十六次回答平均正確率，宏平均較 GRPO 高一點五九至二點六二個百分點；小模型三種種子消融也支持自適應時程優於固定或預設支出。然而七十億模型相對 KnapsackRL 只高零點零六點，四十億模型的「十六次至少答對一次」指標反而較低，不能把不同指標混為全面領先。

論文附有完整推導，但保證針對代理效益函數，不保證真實模型品質或另一條訓練路徑的最優策略。獎勵變異預測雖有排序訊號，平均仍由實際零點一一九高估為零點一五四；它也不是直接估算學習增益。相同回答數不代表相同 token 或更新次數，作者的單次計時僅顯示成本相近。此方法值得用於有限預算的數學後訓練，跨任務、較大模型及穩定重現仍待驗證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant and carefully scoped empirical study of how retrieval progress enters an agent's update. Query-local coverage improves micro F1 by 3.09 percentage points and EM by 3.41 over the outcome-only condition; it is not a relative-percent improvement or a compute-efficiency claim. Mass-preserving permutation tests make action correspondence a useful finding. Stronger causal conclusions remain limited because local and scalar update strengths are not matched, gating changes total credit, only one model/retriever setup is studied, and no multi-seed uncertainty is reported. The benchmark suite informed development. Development coverage is not independent evidence of generalization: 507 of 1,200 questions share training evidence, and coverage-conditioned groups do not contain identical questions. The start-offset detector can credit partially visible mentions; appendix audits quantify this rather than eliminating it. The full PDF is sufficient for a bounded scientific assessment, so missing external releases do not require a blanket material hold. Availability and reproducibility remain unverified.

primary_link.title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Constructing and Assigning Retrieval Credit for Search Agents

papers.summary: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.
papers.summary_en: The study separates what retrieval earns credit from where credit enters GRPO. On one Qwen3-4B model, query-local evidence coverage raises micro F1 from 51.25 to 54.34 across 3,197 questions. Permutation controls support action alignment, but update magnitudes are unmatched, benchmarks informed development, and 507 analysis questions share training evidence. Coverage gains do not establish better evidence use or lower compute. Code, models and data are promised upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
搜尋代理答錯時，並不代表每次搜尋都沒有價值。這篇研究把中途獎勵拆成兩個問題：找到甚麼證據才算進展，以及獎勵應分配給整段回答還是實際發出的查詢。作者用維基百科與知識圖譜組成一萬四千道訓練題，保留子問題、支持段落與相依關係，比較一般證據覆蓋、要求先備證據的覆蓋，以及答案字串命中。局部方法保留最終答案獎勵，另在已執行查詢的 token 加入同題、同步驟的相對信用。

在單一 Qwen3 四十億參數模型與固定檢索器上，七個問答集合共三千一百九十七題的加權 F1，由僅看結果的五十一點二五升至五十四點三四；這是三點零九個百分點。打亂信用與查詢的對應會削弱表現，而要求依賴閉包並未一致更好，顯示證據規則與分配方式需要共同設計。

值得注意的是，測試集合曾參與開發決策，且沒有多次訓練的誤差範圍。局部與整段獎勵未匹配更新強度；遮掉部分組別也會減少總信用量。另有五百零七道分析題與訓練共享證據，覆蓋偵測只要求答案提及的起點落在區塊內。研究支持特定條件下改善取證，還不能證明因果上更善用證據、普遍泛化或節省運算；程式與資料僅承諾接受後釋出。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A practical incremental idea with a clean algebraic identity, but considerably weaker implementation and measurement support than the broad abstract suggests. The 2–6x ratios apply to selected operators, not the entire model or latency. Appendix A.21 contains an adverse eight-block MLP case and finite-backend filtering; BoolQ has negative cases. Several displayed deltas cannot be reconstructed from the adjacent rounded values. Separate aggregation could explain some discrepancies, but its definition and raw runs are not supplied, so exact headline suffix gains are treated as reported rather than independently reconciled. The diagonal weighted proxy is not the full covariance objective; a fixed TT/TTN backend plus arbitrary input scaling is not automatically identical to the unscaled fixed-rank hypothesis class. The full PDF supports bounded review without a material hold, while numerical aggregation, independent generalization and deployment/reproduction claims remain limited.

primary_link.title: Activation-Aware Weight Tensorization: A Calibration-Time Preconditioner for Tensor-Network LLM Compression

papers.summary: Post-training tensor-network compression replaces Transformer linear layers with Tensor Train (TT) or Tree Tensor Network (TTN) operators, but standard decompositions minimize weight-space Frobenius error rather than functional error under the layer's activation distribution. We propose Activation-aware Weight Tensorization (AWT), a training-free calibration wrapper that preconditions each weight matrix with a diagonal activation-derived scale before an unchanged TT/TTN solver and deploys the result with only an input-side elementwise rescaling. Across Llama 3.1 8B, Ministral 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, AWT consistently improves vanilla TT/TTN tensorization at 2-6 times compression: under single-operator replacement, AWT closes 12-35% of the WikiText perplexity gap to the dense baseline across the three model families and 2-6 times compression settings; while under multi-operator Llama suffix replacement it closes 27-60% across attention-group and all-seven-matrix settings. The gains also transfer to downstream HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge evaluations. We further show that diagonal preconditioning is a robustness-modularity tradeoff rather than a diagonal-covariance assumption: a dense full-covariance oracle wins its own weighted objective in 80/81 cases, yet diagonal AWT gives better held-out functional fidelity in 53/81 cases. Together, these results position AWT as a principled, modular preconditioner for improving functional fidelity in fixed TT/TTN compression pipelines without modifying the decomposition solver.
papers.summary_en: AWT rescales weight columns using calibration activations, applies an unchanged TT/TTN solver, and inversely rescales inputs at inference. It improves many fixed tensorization comparisons across three model families, but SVD remains stronger in the reported Llama single-operator test. Matrix compression ratios are not whole-model speedups. Appendix MLP/BoolQ reversals, non-finite runs, unexplained table-delta mismatches and missing implementation details limit deployment and universal-improvement claims.
papers.summary_zh:
把語言模型的矩陣拆成小型張量核心時，數值近似得好，不一定代表模型行為保留得好。AWT 先用少量輸入的活化統計，放大較重要的權重欄位，再交給原有張量列或樹狀張量網路分解器；推論時對輸入做反向逐通道縮放，不必重新訓練或改寫分解器。其數學身分式說明了欄位加權誤差，但不是完整共變異數最佳化的保證。

作者在三種七至八十億參數模型、三個目標壓縮率與七類矩陣上比較。單矩陣替換時，AWT 能縮小原始張量化相對稠密模型的困惑度落差；多矩陣尾端替換也常有較大改善。不過壓縮率是指定矩陣的參數比例，不能直接當成整個模型省下同樣記憶體或加速倍數。相同參數預算的普通 SVD，在列出的 Llama 單矩陣比較仍較好。

附錄使結論需要更保守：八層 MLP 的一個設定反而變差，部分後端產生非有限困惑度，BoolQ 也有下降。幾張表的差值與同列原始數字無法直接對上，可能涉及彙總方式，原始紀錄不足以釐清。校準數量、確切形狀與秩、部署時間及程式釋出也未充分交代。這是值得實驗的模組化改良，尚不是完整模型壓縮、普遍品質提升或實測服務加速的證明。

evidence: PDF pp.1–4, Sections I–III: distinguishes situation-to-thinking prediction from answer/rationale distillation; temporal candidates are evaluated using recurrence, counterexamples, reverse evidence and cross-partition stability. The equations describe a conceptual loop rather than an implementation guarantee.

PDF p.4, Equations 6/11/13: temporary buffer is bounded and confidence can decay, but the cumulative learning set is updated by union with new direct/discovered material. Fixed online model size does not establish bounded total data, maintenance cost or successful forgetting.

PDF p.5, IV.A: all experiments intentionally synthetic; four-layer Transformer, width 192, six heads, FFN 768, dropout 0.1, BCE and AdamW; five seeds and online deepseek-v4-flash. Exact prompts, training schedule, data generator and hardware timing protocol are not provided.

PDF pp.5–7, IV.B/Figures 1–2/Table I: top-four Sequence-RAG and Proposed both achieve 1.000 F1. Sequence-RAG storage grows from 0.156 to 9.360 MB, while the model is 7.358 MB, with an approximate 23,600-history crossover. At 500 histories retrieval is faster (0.0186 versus 0.0382 ms/query) and smaller.

PDF pp.6–7, Table I: at 30,000 histories retrieval is 0.3636 ms/query and policy inference 0.0382, about 9.53x. This comparison excludes LLM generation, offline training, periodic consolidation and hardware disclosure; it is not a measured full-system speedup.

PDF pp.6–7, IV.C–D/Table II: unseen component names and matched summary statistics isolate temporal ordering. Proposed reaches 1.000 F1; order-insensitive Summary-RAG 0.566 and RF-Summary 0.383; same-endpoint Current-State-Only is 0.711. These baselines cannot represent the distinguishing signal by construction.

PDF pp.7–8, IV.E/Figure 3/Tables III–IV: factor F1 0.789→0.868 and decision accuracy 0.484→0.575; all methods already have factor recall 1.000. Reported 320-situation paired bootstrap F1 difference +0.0786, CI [0.0609,0.0974], p<0.001; proposed–RAG difference −0.0089, CI [−0.0302,0.0135], p=0.472 does not establish equivalence or superiority.
PDF p.8, Table III: average tokens are 719.61 for unguided DeepSeek and 728.13 for Proposed+DeepSeek; the experiment does not demonstrate answer-token savings.

PDF pp.7–8, IV.F/Figure 4/Table V: rare-pattern micro-F1 rises from 0.777±0.077 at 100 histories to 0.996±0.005 at 500, then 0.995±0.006 at 1,000 and 0.999±0.001 at 8,000. This is a designed acquisition curve, not a strictly monotone or real-world sample-efficiency guarantee.

PDF pp.8–9, IV.G/Figure 5/Tables VI–VII: Statistics-Only and Proposed+DeepSeek have identical mean relation F1 at all repetition counts (0,0,0.333,1.000). At eight repetitions both attain 1.000 future-thinking accuracy; no-consolidation/unordered/local are 0.333. The paper expressly acknowledges that the LLM does not outperform statistical evidence ranking on this synthetic identification task.

PDF pp.9–10: conclusion, fourteen references and biography complete the ten-page document. The 2015 LaTeX running header and photo placeholder are source-template remnants, not publication-date evidence; no appendix, supplement or code/data release URL was located.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant problem framing with a clear division between lightweight thinking selection and LLM reasoning, but preliminary evidence. Controlled temporal tasks establish that order-preserving inputs help and guidance improves a particular DeepSeek experiment. They do not establish superiority to accurate retrieval or a numerical benefit from LLM consolidation over statistics-only. Fixed inference/model size excludes growing cumulative training data and consolidation costs. Sparse reproducibility details and exclusively synthetic tests warrant substantially lower rigor, generalizability and reproducibility ratings than the perfect task scores might suggest.

primary_link.title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents

papers.summary: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.
papers.summary_en: A small Transformer learns which issues an LLM should consider from temporally ordered experience. Six synthetic studies report factor F1 rising from 0.789 to 0.868, near retrieval-assisted 0.877. The 9.53x speedup measures retrieval versus policy inference, not full response latency or training cost. Statistics-only matches LLM-assisted discovery, so extra consolidation value remains unproven. Read the cost crossover and ablations before extrapolating. All ten pages and every figure/table were read.
papers.summary_zh:
長期代理是否一定要反覆搜尋全部歷史，才能知道現在該注意什麼？這篇研究把經驗轉成「思考方向」標籤，交由小型 Transformer 學習情境到標籤的映射，再讓大型語言模型處理當下細節。情境保留訊號的時間順序；另以週期性整理找出跨事件重複出現的長距離關係，把它們轉成新的訓練材料。

六組實驗全部採用受控合成資料。時間規則與相同終點、不同歷史的任務可達 F1 1.000；加入思考提示後，DeepSeek 的因素辨識 F1 由 0.789 升至 0.868，仍略低於檢索輔助的 0.877，兩者差異不顯著。三萬筆歷史下，策略推論比序列檢索快約 9.53 倍，但這只量測該步驟，並非完整 LLM 回答時間，訓練與鞏固成本也未納入。

先看表一的成本交叉點，再讀表六、七的統計基線：純統計方法與加入 LLM 的關係發現結果完全相同，尚未證明 LLM 鞏固帶來額外數值收益。小歷史下檢索反而更省空間且更快；固定模型大小也不表示累積訓練資料不再增長。全文十頁與全部圖表已讀，未定位到附錄。其價值是清楚拆分「該思考什麼」與「如何推理」，但缺少真實長期部署、完整提示、資料產生細節和硬體計時設定，只宜視為初步機制驗證。

evidence: PDF pp.3–4 §3, Eqs.(1)–(3), pp.15–16 Appendix A: Gaussian random effects separate shared incumbent noise from candidate-specific noise. h_w^2=s^2/(s^2+v_cc/n) shrinks the within-generation selection differential; accepted-gain bias additionally conditions on acceptance. Bayes optimality is one-step with known hyperparameters, not a theorem for adaptive reused-set runs.

PDF p.6 Figure1/§5.1 and p.22 Table2: empirical/Gaussian prediction MAE0.034/0.064 uses the same oracle data and trajectories selected at n256; after the seed rewrite, Qwen2.5 self-proposals improve in4–39% of cases, and heavy tails reach excess kurtosis7.6 in a stronger-proposer condition. Bootstrap intervals omit run-to-run uncertainty.

PDF pp.7,24–25 §5.2/Tables4–6:72 generation-1 commits, with observed/model overstatement9.1/9.0,3.2/3.8,0.1/1.3 points for n16/64/256. Setting-level errors are several points. Delayed first and later commits receive only fresh-set references; the patterns are consistent with lock-in and do not identify a causal mechanism.

PDF pp.7–9 §5.3/Figure2/Table1 and p.23 Table3: four settings, eight paired seeds and nine arms; greedy final selection-minus-held-out gaps13.2–19.6 points at n16 and1.3–4.9 at n256. TREC held-out gains rise13.7→24.2 and14.0→20.4, whereas GSM8K1.5→3.1 is nonsignificant (Holm p.483). Banking77 exploratory degradation does not confirm (−0.6±0.7,p.425).

PDF p.9 Table1: pilot gate minus greedy at n16 pooled32 pairs is−2.1±1.1,p.062; select-confirm−1.6±1.2,p.194. Per-setting pilot GSM8K is worse, Holm p.032. The result is no demonstrated whole-run improvement by tested rules, not equivalence or proof that every acceptance correction fails.

PDF pp.18–21 AppendixB: TREC12 duplicate question texts; removing them yields588-item sensitivity with TREC improvements10.44/6.21 and pooled pilot difference−2.10±1.08. Model revisions not pinned; GSM8K seed item disagreements reach9.8%. Frozen pilot over-subtracts candidate–incumbent rather than candidate–candidate noise, unlike later Figure1 fitting. Analysis code written after16/336 runs finished.

PDF pp.8–10,20–21,26–29 Figure3/Tables8–12: strong-start loop pooled-eight-seed findings and combined inverse-normal p-values are exploratory. GEPA TREC n16 at2250 metric calls reports45.0 versus18.5 held-out gain (26.5 overstatement), compared with−1.9 overstatement atn256; pool sizes91 versus9 and reflections about107 versus≤10 confound equal-compute comparisons. These are validation-score audits, not corrections to GEPA's separately reported test gains.

PDF p.29 Table12 and pp.28–29 MIPROv2: TREC held-out gain5.8→11.4 atn16→256, paired5.6±0.7,p.001; Banking77 reported+5.0 versus held-out−1.6 atn16 (6.6-point overstatement). Ties and first-winner retention explain a limitation of continuous Gaussian prediction, not universal calibration.

Across151 n16 runs, self-report bias/RMSE10.8/15.5 becomes approximately0/5.7; truth is another300-item gold half, and50 splits reuse the finite gold set. Shrinkage alone leaves setting-level bias−8.5 to+5.8.

PDF pp.30–34 Figure4/Tables13–18: isolated fresh-decision pilot improvement does not establish whole-run benefit; leave-one-run-out replay uses only one or two trajectories and conditional intervals. Fresh-versus-reused TREC atn64 is one three-seed, feedback-confounded setting with fewer candidates under fresh sampling. Fixed-budget allocation sweep is inconclusive.

PDF p.11 availability and pp.16–21 AppendixB: paper claims ancillary code, saved run records and reproduction instructions; none are in this supplied review packet. In-file details suffice to critique reported findings, not to verify the ancillary release, preregistration timestamps, raw statistics or model-output reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper is highly relevant to LLM prompt optimization, self-improvement and evaluation reliability. Its contribution is an empirically grounded adaptation of classical winner's-curse results that distinguishes correlated candidate noise, conditioning on acceptance and adaptive reuse. Eight paired seeds in four confirmatory settings, separate feedback pools and within-family Holm correction support the main optimism finding; competent starts and two prompt optimizers add practical value. Negative gate results and failed replication of the exploratory degradation are reported candidly. However, Gaussian, homoscedastic, independent-effect and fresh-set assumptions are restrictive. Figure 1 uses oracle resampling and inputs from the same data, so it is not independent calibration; native first-generation agreement is only aggregate. The frozen pilot over-subtracted total noise, limiting what unsuccessful Bayes gates say about calibrated adoption methods generally. TREC has text overlap despite ID separation, with an author-reported removal sensitivity analysis. The late-written analysis script, GEPA budget/metric changes, added strong-start seeds and post-hoc combined p-values qualify preregistration claims. GEPA is matched in metric calls rather than reflection compute, and a 64-item audit still has roughly six-point error. Lock-in is consistent with the observations but not causally identified. Detailed protocols help, but model revisions were not pinned and the claimed ancillary code, split manifests and run records were neither acquired nor executed here. The result merits a high-relevance, bounded methodological assessment, with discounts for incremental theory, narrow task coverage and unverified reproducibility.

primary_link.title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules

papers.summary: Self-improving LLM systems propose changes to themselves and keep those that score better on a small evaluation set. We treat this keep-if-better step as selection under measurement noise, model the correlated errors of the candidates in a single decision, and study empirically what happens when the evaluation set is reused. In runs where Qwen models rewrite their own instructions and every candidate is also scored on 600 held-out items, most proposals after the first are harmful, and the model gives the size of the winner's curse of a generation's best candidate. With a prior from a separate pilot, it matches the average overstatement of first-generation commits in native loops, though not setting by setting. In a pre-registered study, the final selection-set score of greedy loops exceeded held-out accuracy by 13 to 20 points with 16 selection items and by 1 to 5 points with 256. Held-out gains grew with the selection set on TREC but not on GSM8K, and the tested acceptance rules did not beat greedy acceptance over whole runs. Gains measured on the selection set also exceeded held-out gains when a current model refined a competent instruction, and in the validation scores of GEPA and MIPROv2. Scoring the starting and the current instruction on 64 items never used for selection removes the average bias of a loop's reported gain, but single estimates remain off by about 6 points. Self-improvement studies should report held-out gains with their uncertainty.
papers.summary_en: Selecting the best prompt on a small reused set can exaggerate self-improvement. Qwen loops show final selection-minus-held-out gaps of 13–20 points with 16 items, versus 1–5 with 256. Tested acceptance gates do not beat greedy over complete runs; GEPA and MIPROv2 validation scores are also optimistic. A separate 64-item audit reduces gain-estimation RMSE from 15.5 to 5.7 points. Fresh-set theory, exploratory follow-ups and uninspected ancillary code limit the conclusions; causal lock-in is not established.
papers.summary_zh:
讓語言模型反覆改寫提示，再保留小型測試集上分數最高的版本，究竟是在進步，還是在挑中幸運的雜訊？本文把這個步驟建模為帶相關誤差的候選選擇，區分同代勝出者的優勢、接受修改後的增益高估，以及重複使用評估集造成的累積偏差。

作者在三個分類或數學任務，以 Qwen 模型進行提示改寫，並用六百題保留集評估。確認性實驗中，十六題選擇集的最終分數比保留集高十三至二十個百分點，二百五十六題時縮至一至五點。擴大選擇集提升了 TREC 的實際增益，卻未在 GSM8K 得到相同結果；Bayes 門檻與分割確認也沒有在完整迴圈中勝過貪婪接受。GEPA 與 MIPROv2 的驗證分數同樣偏樂觀，這不等於否定其原論文的獨立測試結果。

最實用的建議是另留未參與選擇的稽核題，對起始與最終版本一起評分。六十四題稽核把小選擇集的增益估計均方根誤差由15.5降至5.7點，仍不足以精確辨識小幅改善。理論依賴新鮮樣本與高斯假設；鎖定機制未被因果識別，部分後續分析為探索性，程式與紀錄也未由本次評審取得。本文適合作為自我改進評估的警示與設計依據，不能當成通用修正方法已獲驗證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: The work closely matches tool-using agents, RL and self-evolving reasoning. Reusing one frozen reference on both sides of an alternating loop is a checkable incremental method, with explicit invalid-output, caching and degeneracy rules. Positive results on thirteen benchmarks across two backbones, domain means and sample standard deviations from five independent Agent0/AnchorLoop runs, matched branch ablations and cost measurements provide meaningful bounded support. However, curriculum-stage models are identical: a positive agreement gap is a sampling-based proxy, not historical improvement. The historical term vanishes for matching majorities or full consensus and can merely rescale the current advantage in two-answer cases. Larger advantage variance and more tool calls do not identify a causal mechanism; Qwen iteration cost rises17.6% without a matched-GPU-hours comparison. Cross-method tool comparisons change several training factors. The paper recognizes these boundaries. Its initial positive-gap frequencies54.7% and approximately56% for MiMo still merit raw sampling checks: under exchangeable identically distributed groups, the expected positive-gap frequency cannot exceed50%, although finite-sample departures alone do not establish an error. Hyperparameters select the best reported grid point without a clearly described independent tuning split; sampling temperature, seeds, exact implementation revisions and numeric answer canonicalization remain underspecified. This is a useful bounded training improvement, not a solution to consensus collapse, a correctness guarantee or evidence of general self-improvement.

primary_link.title: Self-Evolve With a Reference:Anchored Training of Tool-Integrated Agents

papers.summary: Self-evolving tool-integrated agents learn from tasks and feedback generated within their own training loop. A Curriculum Agent generates tasks, while an Executor Agent learns from self-consistency signals through reinforcement learning. However, relying solely on the current Executor for feedback has two limitations: group-relative advantages vanish under full consensus, while uncertainty-based curriculum rewards favor disagreement without showing whether the generated tasks support further learning. These limitations motivate an additional reference beyond the current Executor. We propose \textit{AnchorLoop}, which introduces a frozen copy of the previous iteration's Executor as a historical reference and reuses it on both sides of the training loop. For the Executor, the anchor provides a cross-reference advantage that evaluates current outputs against both current and historical majority answers. For the Curriculum, it provides an agreement-based reference based on differences in sampled majority agreement. Since the Executor and anchor have identical parameters during Curriculum training, this comparison serves as a proxy for task selection rather than evidence of inter-version improvement or correctness. Across 13 reasoning benchmarks, AnchorLoop improves over Agent0 by 2.5\% on mathematical reasoning and 2.8\% on general reasoning tasks. It also maintains higher effective-advantage variance and continues improving in later iterations as the unanchored baseline shows diminishing gains. These results demonstrate the benefit of introducing a lightweight historical reference into self-evolving tool-integrated agents without external task or answer supervision.
papers.summary_en: AnchorLoop reuses a frozen previous Executor for curriculum rewards and cross-reference advantages. Across two backbones, math averages rise 2.5 points over Agent0; general reasoning rises 2.7–2.8. During curriculum training the two models are identical, so agreement gaps reflect sampling, not learning progress. Full consensus still gives zero advantage. Qwen training costs 17.6% more per iteration, leaving equal-compute gains and the causal mechanism unproven.
papers.summary_zh:
自行出題、解題並以答案共識訓練的代理，容易在回饋變單一後停滯。AnchorLoop 每輪保留上一輪執行代理作為凍結參照：解題時比較目前與參照的多數答案，調整相對優勢；出題時比較兩組抽樣的一致率，輔助課程獎勵。這提供另一種內部訊號，卻沒有新增外部正確答案。

十三個基準、兩個骨幹模型的結果顯示，相較 Agent0，數學平均各增加2.5個百分點，一般推理增加2.8與2.7個百分點。主要比較有五次獨立訓練的均值與標準差，並提供分支消融及後期訓練曲線。但出題階段目前模型與參照參數完全相同，差異來自抽樣；一致率差不能解讀為模型已學會新題，完全共識時兩種優勢也仍為零。

成本同樣重要：Qwen3-4B 每輪需24.1小時，Agent0為20.5小時，增加17.6%，因此尚未證明等算力下更有效率。共同答錯、無明確多數與精選案例的限制均須保留；更多工具呼叫也不代表更正確或題目更難。它值得作為自我演化訓練的可檢驗設計，但需要等成本對照、完整程式與抽樣紀錄，才能進一步釐清收益機制。

primary_link.title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement

papers.summary: Environments are the foundation of recursive self-improvement: they provide the problems agents work on and the feedback used to evaluate progress. Yet constructing challenging research environments with reliable evaluation still depends on domain experts, limiting their scale and disciplinary coverage. We introduce RSI-Forge, a multi-agent pipeline that turns published papers into executable environments for self-improvement. Three agents coordinate construction, reproduction, and review to produce tasks with automated evaluators; each paper's method is independently reimplemented to establish a baseline score. We present 210 environments across 18 fields, including 90 reviewed by independent human domain experts. Both experts and agent judges give high ratings to the potential for improving the provided starting solutions and the evaluators' ability to distinguish solution quality, whereas experts are more critical of shortcut resistance, faithfulness to the source paper, and whether a single idea can exhaust a task. To validate their use for repeated improvement, we evaluate four models over 3 successive attempts on 120 environments, with each attempt inheriting prior code and notes while model weights remain fixed. At least one model improves after the first attempt in 84% of environments. Models also outperform the reproduced paper methods in 68 of the 120 environments, demonstrating room for gains beyond these baselines. Transcript analysis identifies work beyond parameter tuning in 95% of these successful attempts. Analysis of the resulting trajectories shows that models scoring lower on these tasks explore less, more often accept gains smaller than the reported standard error, and rely more heavily on tuning to the development set. RSI-Forge provides a scalable approach to constructing research environments for training and evaluating self-improving agents.
papers.summary_en: RSI-Forge uses separate construction, reproduction and review agents to build 210 research environments. Across 120 tasks, fixed-weight solvers improve over three sessions; 68 tasks see a run beat the reproduced baseline. The study does not separate inherited records from extra time or establish scientific novelty. Expert ratings expose fidelity and saturation concerns, and 22 of 480 chains access held-out or cross-run material. Gated assets and undisclosed sourcing limit independent replication.
papers.summary_zh: 如何替研究型代理建立可反覆改進、又能可靠判分的任務？RSI-Forge讓建構、重現與審查代理分工，把論文改編成可執行環境，附上起始解、開發資料、保留測試與獨立重現的基準。作者共建立十八領域、二百一十個環境，其中九十個接受領域專家評閱；再抽取主批次的一百二十個環境，讓四款模型在固定權重下連做三次，後次繼承程式與筆記。以正規化分數提升超過0.01計，84%的環境至少有一款模型在第一次之後進步；六十八個環境至少一次超越重現基準。這些結果支持擴充代理研究任務的供給，也揭露最終提交未必保留最佳解的問題。但超越改編後基準不代表推進原領域科學，三次嘗試亦未分離記憶繼承與額外時間的效益。專家對忠實度、捷徑防護及持續改進空間較保留；四百八十條鏈中二十二條被標記接觸保留材料或其他執行紀錄，排除後模型排序不變，卻不能證明沒有未記錄的接觸。行為標籤也未經人工驗證，所謂95%不只調參不能解讀成95%創新。完整語料須申請，取源程序與逐篇裁決不公開，故適合作為可擴展研究環境的有界證據，尚不足以宣稱已證實通用、開放且可重現的遞迴能力提升。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Score 0.767. Long-term agent memory, evidence coverage and retrieval budgets directly match the priorities. Distinguishing item relevance, set sufficiency, annotation hits and answer quality, together with same-store controls and cost curves, is useful. All LoCoMo conversations had development contact; the 500-question LongMemEval-S evaluation broadens support, but sufficiency is reference-conditioned model labeling, not human validation or online stopping. primary_link.title: Relevance Is Not Sufficiency: What Actually Closes the Evidence Gap in Long-Term Memory QA

papers.summary: LLM agents that interact with a user across many sessions accumulate histories that exceed their context window, so they store past interactions in an external memory and answer each question from a small set of retrieved records. Existing memory systems rank records by lexical or embedding relevance, yet the top-ranked memories can each be relevant while jointly omitting a complementary fact that the answer requires, especially for multi-session and temporal questions. Drawing on the distinction between relevance and sufficiency in legal evidence scholarship, we recast memory retrieval as constructing a sufficient memory set. To operationalize this view, we introduce a blinded LLM judgment over the retrieved set, together with Gold Hit and Turn Hit as evidence-coverage proxies. We then propose Budgeted Flat Reconstruction (BFR), which builds sufficient sets over a fixed flat memory store in two stages. Specifically, we first apply Formal Concept Analysis for Memory Selection (FCA-MS) to decompose the question into information requirements and select a compact candidate subset that jointly covers them. Then, we repeatedly acquire unseen records through deeper text search or complementary entity and session views, stopping when the budget is exhausted. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that BFR outperforms same-store adaptations of recent agent-memory systems in both answer quality and evidence coverage. Specifically, on LongMemEval-S it raises judged accuracy from 72.4% to 82.2% and Turn Hit to 91.4%.
papers.summary_en: BFR composes complementary memories, then adds unseen records through text, entity and session access until a budget is spent. In same-flat-store LongMemEval-S tests, judged accuracy rises from 72.4% to 82.2%; 91.4% Turn Hit is only an evidence-access proxy. Text-only completion wins at equal three-call cost on LoCoMo, whose conversations were all seen in development. Sufficiency needs a reference answer offline. Conflicting appendix gains and an undocumented human-check claim weaken the evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 找回幾段主題相關的舊對話，不代表已湊齊回答所需的證據。本文提出BFR，把長期記憶檢索拆成「組合」與「補齊」：先將問題分解為資訊需求，從擴大的候選池挑選互補筆記、對應回原始對話，再透過文字、人物與會話索引持續取得尚未看過的紀錄，直到固定預算耗盡。停止依據不是模型知道證據已充分，因為文中的充分性評估需參考答案，只能離線使用。在固定對話庫、回答器與評審的LongMemEval-S五百題比較中，多視角版判定正確率由改編Mem0的72.4%提高至82.2%，Turn Hit達91.4%；後者只表示命中至少一筆標註證據，不能當作完整答案已有支持。主要收益來自擴展檢索範圍；在LoCoMo相同三次呼叫下，純文字版反而勝過多視角版，完整結構化記憶系統也不是本文所擊敗的同庫基線。LoCoMo全部會話曾用於開發，不能宣稱未見資料泛化。另須注意，附錄表格的充分性增幅與同頁文字互相矛盾，結論所稱人工檢查亦缺少可核對的設計與結果；這些疑點降低證據強度。這篇的實用價值是提醒記憶系統追求互補、可追溯的證據集合，並把更深檢索的成本算清楚，而非把較高命中率包裝成可靠的充分性判定。

llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper directly concerns general personalized language-agent memory, retrieval and inexpensive routing; health scenarios are illustrations rather than its sole methodological target. Combining type-specific graphs with active-labeling-style routing is practically useful, although the ingredients have precedents. PAL-Set selection improves by 6.36 points over 29.22; typed vectors contribute 8.51 points over unified vectors, with graphs adding 1.92. HGP leads three overall LoCoMo metrics but trails Mem0 on F1, so universal superiority is unsupported. Ablations, full prompts and 27 configurations improve inspectability. However, main-result uncertainty, PAL sample counts and router-label provenance are insufficiently detailed, and shared generator/judge bias lacks human calibration. Equation15 omits the LatencyNorm−1 offset described in prose and cannot reproduce Table5 scores; router results in Tables4–6 lack clear experiment mapping. Disjoint per-stage test subsets avoid reuse but confound gains with subset difficulty and cannot establish absence of forgetting. The 4.98ms result is router latency, not a demonstrated end-to-end device cost; construction, generation, storage and hardware costs remain unclear. Working memory is illustrated by a constructed case only. These limits reduce rigor, generalizability and reproducibility while preserving bounded design and benchmark value; qualitative health examples are not safety validation.

primary_link.title: HGP:An on-device personalized agent memory via hybrid graph storage

papers.summary: LLM-based agents face challenges in personalized interactive tasks due to heterogeneous, multi-typed, and implicitly constrained long-term traces. Existing memory mechanisms struggle with accurate routing and retrieval, especially on-device where personalization is critical. Most methods use single-vector representations, blurring type distinctions and relational structure. We propose HGP, a hybrid graph memory framework. HGP employs a lightweight self-enhancement classifier for personalized memory routing and constructs episodic, semantic, and procedural memories as graphs. It also extracts working memory as a state trajectory to capture current state and implicit constraints, ensuring reliable decision-making. The classifier reduces large-model calls, enabling on-device deployment, while graph storage enables accurate retrieval and incremental user profile refinement. Experiments on two benchmarks show that on PAL-Set solution selection, HGP achieves an S-score of 35.58, nearly 7 points above the strongest baseline. Code and data are at https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git.
papers.summary_en: HGP routes personal memories into event graphs, knowledge graphs and rule trees, using a small classifier with LLM fallback. PAL-Set selection reaches 35.58 versus 29.22 for HippoRAG2, but typed vectors already score 33.66. Working memory has only an illustrative case. Router latency is not end-to-end device latency, and an appendix scoring equation conflicts with its table. The modular design is useful; broad safety and deployment claims remain unverified.
papers.summary_zh:
個人助理需要分清曾發生的事件、穩定偏好、可重用流程與眼前待辦，單一向量記憶容易混淆這些訊息。HGP 用輕量分類器分流記憶，遇到低信心樣本才請大型模型標註，再把標註回饋訓練；事件圖、知識圖與規則樹分別保存不同內容，另以狀態軌跡表示工作記憶。

在 PAL-Set，方案選擇的 S-score 為35.58，高於 HippoRAG2 的29.22。消融更值得注意：只保留記憶類型的向量方法已達33.66，混合圖再增加1.92分，不能把全部進步歸因於圖結構。LoCoMo 的整體判分、BLEU-1與精確匹配領先，但F1略低於Mem0；工作記憶則只有單一構造案例，尚未量化其可靠性。
