llm_evaluation.rationale: This directly addresses LLM agents, skill memory and reinforcement learning. Holding the pre-update actor, task and recorded trajectories fixed, while excluding the two proposer-visible trajectories from feedback references, gives a concrete low-rollout-cost credit-assignment design. Support regularization also has three-run validation curves and explicit collapse cases. However, the likelihood contrast is a proxy, not an unbiased counterfactual utility estimate, and much of the machinery adapts established policy optimization. Main results include three-training-run means and standard deviations, no-retrieval evaluation, unseen environments, a smaller backbone and critic alternatives. Most baselines are quoted without comparable uncertainty, and Table 2 gives no error bars; the 0.9/1.8-point advantages over Skill1 do not establish statistical significance. Alignment analysis covers two early checkpoints and 100 eligible, critic-accepted proposals per checkpoint on training queries, with 32 rollouts per condition and correlations of 0.312/0.367. It is not unseen-task calibration. Positive-score negative-gain proposals, including cases passing both admission inequalities, are candidly shown. Excluding proposer inputs requires at least two successes and two failures per group, which can favor intermediate-difficulty tasks; the shrinking proposal supply cannot be attributed to skillbank maturity from Figure 1 alone. No-retrieval gains support shared-policy improvement but do not isolate skill distillation from auxiliary proposer gradients or other training effects. Figure 3 measures four stages without hardware or complete optimization costs. Prompts, 18 equations and hyperparameters aid reconstruction, but the available-code versus planned-release statements conflict; implementation, raw rollouts, exact model revisions and evaluation manifests were not verified. I therefore assign high relevance and useful bounded evidence, with discounts for incremental novelty, incomplete comparison uncertainty, narrow generalization and unverified reproducibility.

Alignment analysis covers two early checkpoints and 100 eligible, critic-accepted proposals per checkpoint on training queries, with 32 rollouts per condition and correlations of 0.312/0.367. It is not unseen-task calibration. Positive-score negative-gain proposals, including cases passing both admission inequalities, are candidly shown. Excluding proposer inputs requires at least two successes and two failures per group, which can favor intermediate-difficulty tasks; the shrinking proposal supply cannot be attributed to skillbank maturity from Figure 1 alone. No-retrieval gains support shared-policy improvement but do not isolate skill distillation from auxiliary proposer gradients or other training effects. Figure 3 measures four stages without hardware or complete optimization costs. Prompts, 18 equations and hyperparameters aid reconstruction, but the available-code versus planned-release statements conflict; implementation, raw rollouts, exact model revisions and evaluation manifests were not verified. I therefore assign high relevance and useful bounded evidence, with discounts for incremental novelty, incomplete comparison uncertainty, narrow generalization and unverified reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 高度符合語言模型代理、技能記憶與強化學習的偏好。方法把更新前執行者、同一任務及既有軌跡固定，並排除提案者看過的兩條軌跡再評分，對共同演進中的信用分配提出具體且節省環境互動的設計；操作支援正則化亦有三次訓練曲線與失敗模式佐證。原理仍建立在動作似然代理及既有策略最佳化上，非無偏反事實效用估計。主結果報三次訓練平均與標準差，含無檢索、未見環境、較小模型和critic變體，但多數基線轉引且沒有同等不確定度，Table2亦未報誤差；與Skill1的0.9及1.8百分點差距不能據此宣稱顯著。對齊分析僅兩個早期checkpoint、每次一百個可評分且critic接受的訓練任務提案，每條件32個rollout，相關係數0.312／0.367；這不是未見任務上的效用校準。正分負增益與通過雙門檻的反例已誠實展示。訓練需要同組至少兩成功、兩失敗才能留下互不重用的對照，可能偏向中等難度任務；後期可評分提案變少不能單憑Fig.1歸因於技能庫成熟。無檢索提升支持共享策略改善，卻未獨立隔離技能蒸餾與輔助提案梯度等機制。Fig.3只量四個階段，未交代硬體與完整更新成本。提示、18式與超參數完整，但實作連結與計畫公開的陳述矛盾，程式、原始rollout、模型revision及評估清單未核實。因此給高相關、良好但有界的證據評分，對新意、嚴謹度、泛化和重現性保留折扣。

scope_assessment.reason: General language-model agent and textual-skill learning methodology; ALFWorld and WebShop are interactive language benchmarks, not a pure robotics/domain-only contribution.

primary_link.title: UniSkill: Learning Actor-Aligned Skill Proposals for an Evolving Policy

papers.summary: Large language model agents can improve across tasks by retaining reusable skills distilled from prior interactions. Recent work jointly optimizes task execution and skill extraction, enabling the policy and skillbank to co-evolve. However, as the actor continues learning, rewarding skill proposals through their reuse in subsequent training steps may conflate skill benefits with actor improvement, while directly testing each proposed skill requires costly additional actor rollouts. In this paper, we introduce UniSkill, which uses a shared policy to interact with the environment and propose skillbank edits (Add, Update, or No Edit) from the resulting trajectories. Specifically, the actor learns from environment rewards, while contrastive action feedback guides skill proposal learning. This feedback provides an actor-alignment signal by measuring how replacing the retrieved skill with a proposed skill changes the current actor's action log-likelihood gap between previously collected successful and failed trajectories from the same task, thereby avoiding new rollouts for each proposal. Since proposal-level feedback may suppress an otherwise appropriate edit operation when the proposed skill content scores poorly, we further apply skill-edit support regularization to preserve exploration. Empirically, UniSkill achieves strong performance, reaching 98.4% success on ALFWorld and 84.7% on WebShop while maintaining stable joint training. Further ALFWorld experiments show that UniSkill remains effective when the shared policy uses a smaller backbone. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LimOkii/UniSKill.
papers.summary_en: UniSkill jointly trains an actor and skill proposer, using fixed-trajectory likelihood contrasts instead of fresh rollouts for every proposal. Three runs reach 98.4% ALFWorld valid-seen success and 84.7% on WebShop. Support regularization preserves edit exploration. Yet 24.5% and 15.6% of positive-score proposals hurt fixed-actor success at two checkpoints. Mostly quoted baselines, narrow model/task coverage and an unverified code release limit the evidence; stage timings are not end-to-end training speedups.
papers.summary_zh:
代理一邊練習任務、一邊累積技能時，後來成功究竟來自好技能，還是模型本身進步？UniSkill讓同一語言模型兼任任務執行者與技能提案者，提出新增、更新或不修改。它固定更新前的模型，替換既有成功與失敗軌跡中的技能，衡量兩者動作對數似然差如何改變，避免為每個候選技能重新跑環境；另用正則化維持三種操作的探索機會。

以Qwen2.5-7B為基礎，三次訓練的ALFWorld主要驗證集成功率為98.4%，WebShop為84.7%。移除技能檢索後仍有96.1%的ALFWorld成功率，支持訓練收益不只存在技能庫中；未見環境評估也有98.2%。不過主要比較採用valid_seen分割，多數基線數字轉引前作，不能將小幅領先直接當成統計顯著。

這個回饋是便宜而有用的代理指標，不是技能效用保證。兩個檢查點中，正分提案仍有24.5%與15.6%讓固定模型的實測成功率下降；額外成功軌跡門檻也未排除全部反例。研究目前限於兩個模擬環境、同一模型家族，計時只涵蓋列出的訓練階段，程式公開狀態在文內說法不一且未另行核實。值得參考的是技能評分與探索設計，而非已解決通用代理的長期自我改進。

llm_evaluation.rationale:
This is highly relevant language-agent methodology: it separates learning a knowledge curator from changing the executor and rewards the extra utility of an entry beyond the currently retrieved bank. The promising contribution is the combination of a standalone-success reward, matched-task marginal success, and local context-sensitive token credit, not an established mutual-information estimator. Equation6 takes an absolute log ratio against the mean probability under alternative contexts, with the same generated prefix held fixed. It therefore rewards both increased and decreased source-conditioned probability. No MI lower bound, consistency result or theorem connecting this proxy to bank redundancy is supplied.

The empirical result is substantial against the paper's task-success-only GRPO comparator. With a frozen Qwen3.5-4B executor and k=10, Table1 reports54.0±0.4% ALFWorld SR,66.4±2.6 WebShop score and42.0±2.0% WebShop SR across three seeds, versus37.1±3.7,49.0±4.8 and23.3±2.1. These are16.9/17.4/18.7-point mean differences, not relative percentages or confidence intervals. Against the strongest ALFWorld baseline SkillRL, the overall gain is only2.8 points, and Pick Two declines from GRPO39.2 to27.5. In Table2, MI added to SR improves ALFWorld/WebShop SR by8.9/17.4 points; MSR added on top improves them by8.0/1.3. The absent SR+MSR arm prevents a full factorial decomposition or a claim that MI is necessary for marginal rewards to help. Table2 gives means without dispersion or paired tests, so the small WebShop MSR increment is especially uncertain.

Figures3–4 show robustness over retrieval counts, not continued growth of a learning bank. The evaluation bank is generated separately after training, normally has50 entries, and retrieval is performed once from the initial task query. Observed context lengths are not matched token budgets. Lower retrieval-task Jaccard overlap (12.92 versus13.58% ALFWorld;15.35 versus24.48% WebShop) is an indirect association, not a semantic-redundancy or causal-mechanism measurement. The selected AppendixB cases illustrate distinct guidance, not unbiased bank-wide coverage. AppendixA correctly proves height scaling and decreasing Gaussian-envelope coverage with width only under fixed per-entry area and fixed centers. The idealization assumes perfect selection and no entry interactions; actual marginal success can be negative, and narrow profiles at fixed height are not guaranteed to help.

Transfer at k=8 is a genuine strength within the tested environments. All eight additional executors improve over their no-knowledge baselines on all three metrics. Compared with GRPO, Knowledge Weaver wins ALFWorld SR and WebShop score for seven of eight each, and WebShop SR for six, with one tie and one loss. This is not universal dominance. The training/evaluation task separation is explicitly described:134 ALFWorld valid_unseen tasks and100 of500 WebShop test tasks; training trajectories, reward tasks and bank-generation sources may overlap training tasks. No held-out semantic-contamination audit or uncertainty over WebShop subset choice is provided. Skill1/SkillRise are adapted to curator/frozen-executor bank evaluation, so the comparison does not establish superiority over their original joint-training systems. Human-bank construction lacks volunteer-count/effort reporting, and SkillRL is excepted from the50-entry size constraint.

Detailed prompts and AppendixF make the method inspectable, including local MI added after return computation, sample-standard-deviation normalization, clipped sampled log-ratio regularization and a detached version-interpolated proximal denominator. This is more specific than generic GRPO and should survive reproduction. The PDF links a code repository, but code, checkpoints, raw runs, task IDs and release availability were not acquired or executed here. Computational cost and broad deployment utility remain unverified. Overall, the weighted0.823 score values a well-aligned, useful empirical curator-training contribution while discounting incomplete mechanism isolation, limited statistical evidence and the gap between fixed-bank improvement and continual self-improvement.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
本文直接研究語言代理的方法：把知識整理器的學習與執行器參數更新分開，並獎勵新條目相對既有檢索庫的額外效用。值得重視的是單條成功率、匹配任務的邊際成功差，以及局部脈絡敏感詞元回饋的結合，而不是互資訊估計已被證明。式6固定生成詞元與前綴，比較來源脈絡機率與其他脈絡平均機率，再取對數絕對值。因此來源使機率增加或降低都可獲得獎勵；文中沒有給出互資訊下界、一致性結果，或將此代理訊號連到知識去冗餘的定理。

相對本文只按任務成功訓練的GRPO，實證提升明顯。在凍結Qwen3.5-4B、檢索十條的設定，表1三種子的ALFWorld成功率為54.0±0.4%，WebShop分數66.4±2.6、成功率42.0±2.0%；GRPO分別為37.1±3.7、49.0±4.8、23.3±2.1。差距是16.9、17.4與18.7點，不能寫成相對百分比，±也不是信賴區間。對最強ALFWorld基準SkillRL，整體僅高2.8點；Pick Two更由GRPO的39.2降至27.5。表2在SR上加MI，兩環境成功率增加8.9與17.4點，再加MSR則增加8.0與1.3點。缺少SR+MSR一列，無法完整分解交互作用，也不能聲稱MI是邊際獎勵有效的必要條件。表2沒有離散程度或配對檢定，尤其WebShop的1.3點增量仍不確定。

圖3–4驗證的是不同檢索數量下的固定庫表現，不是學習中的知識庫長期持續成長。評估庫在訓練後另行生成，通常含五十條，以起始任務查詢只檢索一次；曲線的實際詞元數並非匹配的預算。檢索任務集合的Jaccard重疊較低，ALFWorld為12.92對13.58%、WebShop為15.35對24.48%，這只是間接關聯，不能視為語意去冗餘或因果機制的測量。附錄B選例有助理解不同操作，但不是無偏的全庫覆蓋調查。附錄A的高斯包絡證明在固定中心、固定每條面積下成立，寬度增大會降低覆蓋；它假設完美選取且忽略條目交互作用，實際邊際成功卻可能為負，固定高度時縮窄也不保證改善。

跨模型轉用是有價值的證據。表3在k=8下，八個額外執行器的三個指標均勝過自身無知識基準；但相對GRPO，ALFWorld成功率與WebShop分數各七勝一負，WebShop成功率六勝、一平、一負，並非全面勝出。資料角色有清楚區分：測試涵蓋134個ALFWorld valid_unseen任務及500個WebShop測試任務中的100個；訓練軌跡、獎勵任務與產庫來源可以共享訓練任務。文中未提供語意污染稽核或抽取WebShop子集的不確定性。Skill1與SkillRise被調整為整理器加固定執行器的庫評估，不能據此宣稱勝過它們原本的聯合訓練系統；人工作庫缺志工數量與工時，SkillRL也不受五十條庫的相同大小限制。

完整提示與附錄F提高可檢查性，包括回報計算後才加入局部MI、樣本標準差正規化、裁切的取樣對數比正則項，以及混合政策版本後停止梯度的近端分母。重現時必須保留這些細節，不能只稱為一般GRPO。PDF雖有程式庫連結，本次未取得或執行程式、檢查點、原始紀錄、任務ID，也未核驗發布可用性；計算成本與廣泛部署效用仍未知。綜合加權0.823，肯定其與需求高度相關、實證有用的整理器訓練設計，同時對機制隔離不全、統計證據有限，以及固定庫改善與持續自我改進間的距離扣分。

scope_assessment.reason: Language-model knowledge curation, retrieval and policy optimization are the contribution; ALFWorld and WebShop are textual test environments, not a pure robotics or shopping application.

primary_link.title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.
papers.summary_en: Knowledge Weaver trains a curator while freezing the executor, combining standalone success, marginal gains over retrieved knowledge and MI-inspired token feedback. At k=10, success reaches 54.0% on ALFWorld and 42.0% on WebShop, 16.9 and 18.7 points above SR-only GRPO. Transfer to eight other executors is encouraging but uneven. The absolute likelihood contrast is not a proven MI estimator; missing SR+MSR ablation, three seeds and fixed-bank tests limit causal and continual-learning claims. Code was not inspected.
papers.summary_zh:
代理把經驗寫進記憶庫，不代表新增內容真的帶來新能力。本文的 Knowledge Weaver 凍結任務執行模型，只訓練整理經驗的模型：除了獎勵單條知識的成功率，也比較加入既有檢索結果前後的成功差異，並以同一詞元在不同軌跡脈絡下的機率差提供局部回饋，鼓勵留下與經驗有關的資訊。

使用 Qwen3.5-4B、每次檢索十條知識時，ALFWorld 與 WebShop 成功率為54.0%與42.0%，比只按任務成功訓練的 GRPO 高16.9與18.7個百分點。加入資訊回饋後，再加入邊際獎勵，在兩環境分別多提升8.0與1.3點。知識庫也能轉用到八個其他固定模型，但並非每個指標都勝過 GRPO。

閱讀時要分清：所謂互資訊只是取絕對值的機率對比訊號，沒有證明它估計或最大化真正的互資訊；高斯覆蓋理論也假設理想選取、忽略知識間干擾。實驗僅三次種子、兩個環境，缺少單獨加入邊際獎勵的消融；檢索數量增加不等於長期知識庫持續成長。本次未取得或執行作者程式。這是一個值得參考的記憶整理訓練方法，證據支持固定知識庫的效用改善，尚不能保證持續自我改進。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Score 0.6845. The work directly addresses LLM agents, prompt injection and red-team evaluation, giving relevance 0.93. The harm-reweighted score-function identity is clear and proved; combining multiple rollouts with stochastic surrogate exploration is useful, but the identity is a standard reweighting and the implementation has no approximation or convergence guarantee, giving novelty 0.66. Positive normalization, fixed support and input-independent harm must be retained. Differentiating an expectation whose reweighted distribution also changes introduces an additional term, so local direction agreement is not global objective equivalence. Rigor is 0.48 because total compute is not matched, exploration and screening are not separately ablated, and seeds and intervals are absent. Three benchmarks and two models provide bounded evidence, but single-rollout evaluation, action-hit proxies, six inconsistent averages in Tables 1, 5 and 7 and conflicting Figure 4 settings reduce evidence strength to 0.50. White-box 8B ReAct agents and one decoding setting do not establish transfer to larger or closed models, giving generalizability 0.42. The PDF supplies algorithms, parameters and a public-code link, but code, per-case data and environments were not obtained and release claims were not independently verified, giving reproducibility 0.49. The full 19-page PDF supports this bounded critical review without establishing research-asset completeness or replication.

primary_link.title: From Expected Harmfulness to Likelihood: A Probabilistic Reformulation of Jailbreaking LLM Agents

papers.summary: When the harmfulness of an LLM agent's output can be quantified, a natural jailbreaking objective is to maximize expected harmfulness over admissible input modifications. An alternative approach constructs or selects harmful target outputs and modifies the input to increase their likelihood. We establish a precise connection between these two approaches through a probabilistic reformulation. Specifically, we show that the gradient of the logarithm of expected harmfulness with respect to the input equals the expected input gradient of the model's log-likelihood under a harmfulness reweighted output distribution. This identity provides a unified interpretation of expected harmfulness and target likelihood optimization. Building on this connection, we propose OPUR, a sampling distribution designed to generate highly harmful target outputs and use the resulting samples to guide likelihood-based input optimization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the resulting method in jailbreaking LLM agents.
papers.summary_en: OPUR connects log expected harm to a likelihood gradient under a harm-reweighted output distribution, then uses rollout-derived surrogate contexts. Reported gains span two 8B models and three benchmarks, but final evaluation uses one rollout per case. The theory does not validate the surrogate sampler, target-action appearance does not establish completed harm, and inconsistent table averages and figure settings limit confidence. The study motivates stronger distribution-aware agent safety evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 代理安全評估該只看某次失敗，還是整個輸出分布？本文把期望危害的對數梯度，寫成危害加權分布下的概似梯度，連結行為風險與目標輸出的最佳化。OPUR以多條模型軌跡構造候選情境，透過隨機選擇與篩選，避免只追逐單一軌跡。作者在兩款八十億參數模型、三個代理基準測試：Llama的AgentHarm平均成功率報為75%，比最強UDora高13.07個百分點；兩模型在InjecAgent只各高2點，WebShop各高約8.34點，Ministral的AgentHarm則與基準持平。這些結果支持隨機軌跡值得納入紅隊評估，但定理只建立固定當前加權分布的局部方向關係，未證明實作真從該分布取樣。成功例子也僅顯示目標動作出現，包含工具回傳錯誤，不能視為真實危害完成。最終評估每例只抽一次，未提供重複種子、信賴區間或等總成本比較；表一、五、七共有六處分項與平均不一致，圖四設定文字互相矛盾。本文價值在於提醒評測要分開目標命中、實際任務結果與隨機穩定性，仍需更嚴謹的重複評測才能確認改善幅度與跨模型適用性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Score 0.607. Post-training, LLM safety and human evaluation give relevance 0.84. Sequential comparison is useful, but established SFT/IPO on one model lineage gives novelty 0.56. Random assignment of 835 people, ten topics per participant and disclosure of exclusions and assumption failures are strengths. There is no unmisaligned or persuasion-only base-model arm, so the first stage and cross-stage contributions cannot be independently identified; reused data, added training and model selection are not separated. The initial ANCOVA violates equal slopes. The three t-contrast degrees of freedom match unadjusted two-sample comparisons and do not establish conditional effects from the interaction model. Post-hoc wild bootstrap does not resolve the directional disagreement between page27 contrasts and Figure3, giving rigor 0.40 and evidence 0.48. Table2 approximately reproduces d=0.30 and the mean differences, but nonsignificant IPO/GPT-4 comparisons do not prove equivalence, as page30 acknowledges. The control is a single stance statement rather than length-matched neutral argumentation, and only model conditions are personalized, bundling several differences. Generalizability is 0.36: US English-speaking Prolific adults, preselected high-change topics, immediate measurement and no dialogue or behavioral outcomes. Reproducibility is 0.38: the PDF and appendices are readable and a data DOI is provided, but raw data, analysis code, realized stimuli and checkpoints were not acquired, so conditional contrasts cannot be adjudicated or analyses rerun. There is no preregistration, and the no-intervention rationale for absent IRB review is in tension with randomized exposure; clarification is needed without inferring a regulatory violation. The complete PDF supports a bounded critical review, not independent confirmation of the conclusions.

primary_link.title: Successive Training Stages and Large Language Model Persuasion: Effects of Misalignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Optimization

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can be tuned to influence human attitudes, yet the respective contributions of successive post-training stages remain un-clear. This study examines how three successive training stages affect LLM persuasiveness: (1) misalignment through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on conspiracy data, (2) additional persuasive SFT on argumentative data, and (3) Identity Preference Optimization (IPO), a preference-optimization method. A total of 835 participants recruited on Prolific were randomly assigned to five between-subject conditions (neutral text, conspiracy-trained model, persuasion-trained model, preference-optimized model, and GPT-4) and were exposed to texts on 10 divisive political issues, personalized from their individual profiles in all model conditions. Attitude change was measured as the difference between pre- and post-exposure positions on continuous Likert scales and analyzed with an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA). A significant condition x baseline-attitude interaction, F (4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001, indicated that training effects depended on participants' initial attitudes. Persuasive SFT produced greater attitude change than conspiracy training alone, d = 0.30, whereas IPO provided no additional benefit, d = 0.03, and GPT-4 did not differ from neutral text, d = --0.01. These results show that targeted supervised training on persuasive data increases LLM persuasiveness, whereas preference optimization yields no significant gains beyond it.
papers.summary_en: A randomized study of 835 US participants compares texts from successive training stages, GPT-4 and a control. Persuasive SFT has a reported d=0.30 over conspiracy-only SFT; no significant IPO increment is found. Null results do not establish equivalence. Missing base-model controls, unmatched control text, unregistered analyses and conflicting conditional contrasts limit interpretation. The study measures immediate attitudes, not lasting behavior; linked replication data were not acquired.
papers.summary_zh: 模型的後訓練是否會改變對人的說服力？本研究將835名美國Prolific受試者隨機分至五組，閱讀十個議題的文字，量測立即前後態度差異。三個實驗模型依序接受陰謀語料、說服語料的監督式微調，以及IPO偏好最佳化，另設GPT-4與控制文字。作者報告追加說服微調相較僅陰謀訓練的效果量為d＝0.30；IPO追加效果與GPT-4相較控制的差異均未顯著，但未顯著不代表已證明等效或無效。研究有真人隨機實驗的價值，卻沒有未經陰謀訓練的母模型對照，不能分離第一階段的作用；控制組也只是未個人化的立場句，與模型文字並非內容或長度匹配。更重要的是，原定分析的等斜率假設不成立，事後加入調節迴歸，而正文的條件對比與圖三呈現的方向不一致，尚待原始資料釐清。結果只涉及單一模型訓練鏈、特選議題與即時靜態閱讀，無法證明長期態度或行為改變。作者坦承未預先註冊，引用的複現資料本次未取得。因此適合把它當作後訓練可能影響人類態度的初步證據與評測警訊，不宜當成普遍訓練法則或政治說服成效的確證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: This strongly matches language agents, reasoning routing and real-time inference cost; Doom is a testbed rather than a pure game-control or vision-only contribution. The contribution integrates fast non-generative decisions, event-triggered reasoning and persistent plans while the environment continues, and separates accuracy, calibration and error sensitivity. Deferral, progress triggers and asynchronous dual systems have substantial precedents, so novelty lies mainly in the concrete integration and diagnosis. The 900 questions come from 42 games; game-level interval resampling respects correlated questions. Five hundred repeated game-half selection splits address some test-selection optimism, but reuse the same data pool and are not 500 independent replications. The supported result is improvement over equal-rate random deferral, not superiority to both standalone models; correlation across 18 actor/order pairs is also dependent, single-domain evidence. Because the oracle never chooses exploration, retreat or waiting, offline accuracy cannot substitute for completing a game. The loop has one map, three seeds and 33 games with no exits. A fixed exploration control usefully challenges attributing coverage to thought content, but different latency and plan-guided exposure prevent an equal-intervention reasoning ablation. Bare versus committed variants also change knowledge, repeat restrictions and minimum plan duration, so commitment alone is not causally isolated. Death means lack uncertainty estimates and do not establish a survival advantage. Seventeen missing-key explanations identify a concrete failure under a state representation that cannot distinguish locked from ordinary doors; verbalized thoughts are not systematically validated as faithful. Shuffling affects actors only, with thinker answers retained from fixed order, and uncertainty thresholds use test-set percentiles. Page 7 omits Julia's .44 from its stated shuffled-AUROC range; the abstract's collection-bias generalization also has Kev0.8B and shuffled-Julia exceptions, so this review follows the detailed table/text. Hardware, some commits and script names are supplied, but full prompts, per-question records, model-file revisions and code availability require external artifacts that were not acquired or executed here. Overall this is a useful, candid diagnostic agent study with limited generalization.

primary_link.title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?

papers.summary: Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model. In real-time settings the slow model usually runs continuously; in turn-based agents and robot planners it is invoked on events such as uncertainty or a detected failure. We study a fast learned actor that takes every decision and hands control to a reasoning vision-language model only when a gate opens, while the game keeps running. We use closed-loop Doom and the new open "System One" typed-decision models, served through a common llama.cpp interface. On 900 held-out questions, (i) zero-shot decision models from 0.15B to 9B parameters choose to collect items 1.6-1.8 times more often than chance among their errors, in any option order, although the order changes some models' accuracy; (ii) accuracy, calibration and sensitivity (how well confidence separates right from wrong answers) are distinct: models of similar accuracy differ widely in AUROC, and the confidence of the most sensitive one tracks which kinds of situation it fails, not which answers are wrong; (iii) offline, deferring the least confident 30% of decisions to a reasoning model gains over random deferral in proportion to the actor's AUROC (rank correlation 0.87); with actor and rate chosen on held-out games the gain is +0.13 [0.08, 0.18] with doomLaya's option order and +0.08 [0.02, 0.14] with shuffled options, and reasoning carries about half of it; (iv) in closed loop (33 games, three seeds) no variant reaches the exit. Committing to plans, the reasoner's or a fixed explore rule's, opens more doors and makes an actor that stands still play; with the rule the agent dies more often. Told that some doors need keys, the reasoner takes ordinary doors for locked ones, which the state cannot tell apart; without that knowledge it goes back to collecting. We release code, prompts, data and logs.
papers.summary_en:
Can a small model act quickly while a larger model thinks only when it gets stuck? System Switch connects typed-decision actors to an asynchronous vision-language reasoner. Low confidence, stalled movement, blocked commands, repeated actions and lack of exploration trigger thinking. The game continues meanwhile, and the resulting plan can control multiple steps.

A rule-based oracle labels 900 Doom questions. When actors and deferral rates are selected on separate games, confidence-based routing improves accuracy over random routing by 13 and 8 percentage points for fixed-order and shuffled-order actors, respectively; the latter still uses fixed-order thinker answers. This does not establish superiority to the better standalone model. Base Laya confidence mainly distinguishes easy from difficult situation categories, rather than correct from incorrect answers within a category.

None of the 33 closed-loop games, with three seeds per setting, reaches the exit. A fixed exploration rule achieves comparable or greater coverage. Reasoning variants average fewer deaths, but the tiny sample cannot establish that advantage. With game basics and persistent plans, the median age of the frame when a plan starts ranges from 9 to 29 seconds across settings; the offline oracle never rewards exploration. The paper usefully separates confidence, plan persistence and state-information bottlenecks; its external code and data were not verified, and it does not establish a general real-time agent solution.
papers.summary_zh:
小模型快速行動，大模型只在卡住時思考，真的能兼顧速度與能力嗎？System Switch把型別化決策模型接上非同步視覺語言推理器，以低信心、移動停滯、指令受阻、重複行動及探索不足觸發；思考期間遊戲仍繼續，產出的計畫可持續控制多個步驟。

研究用同一規則標註器建立九百題Doom測試集。按遊戲分割資料來選模型與轉交比例後，信心分流比隨機分流的答題正確率高十三及八個百分點，分別對應固定與打亂選項的執行者；後者的推理器仍看固定順序。這未證明組合勝過較佳的單一模型。Laya基礎版的信心主要辨識容易或困難的情境類別，並不能可靠區分類別內的對錯。

真正閉環的三十三局、每設定三個種子，全部未通關。固定探索規則也能達到相近或更大的探索範圍；推理版本平均死亡較少，但樣本太小，尚不足以確立優勢。含基本知識並持續執行計畫的各設定中，計畫開始時畫面已過時的中位數為九至二十九秒；規則答案又從不獎勵探索，凸顯離線分數與實際任務的落差。這篇的價值是拆出信心、計畫持續性與狀態資訊的瓶頸；外部程式及資料未核實，不是已驗證的通用即時代理方案。

llm_evaluation.rationale:
This is relevant language-model methodology, with character-serialized puzzles used to isolate soft versus discrete reasoning states. The central contribution is the combination of an accumulated-candidate representation, fixed-hard-state interventions and probing. It is not a demonstration of natural-language reasoning improvement or a new flow-matching objective. The model predicts clean-token probabilities from a Gaussian-to-one-hot path and retains a continuous state until final argmax.

Theorem1 follows by an integrating factor along the realized ODE trajectory: Z_t=(1-t)Z_0+t Ebar_t for 0<t<1. Ebar_t is a convex mixture of complete one-hot sequences, built from instantaneous products of token marginals. AppendixC explicitly says this does not mean storing a general joint distribution over complete valid solutions. Consequently, geometric coexistence and positive attention weights establish availability, not coherent path search, use of all alternatives, correctness or a speedup theorem. Theorem2 carefully preserves hard outputs while lowering one strict nonwinner and decomposes a scalar margin derivative into Q/K attention reweighting, V transmission and residual-interface terms. These terms can cancel or have either sign. Its tight oscillation/2 approximation bound applies to one fixed intervention path, context and time. The Euler corollary has a small-step winner-gap condition; it does not guarantee behavior of every practical sampling step. Theorem3 bounds population unweighted BCE with explicit decoder excess-risk terms. Matching a finite decoder's architecture and updates does not equalize those terms, and the theorem does not directly bound the reported F1.

Empirically, the strongest result is few-step maze accuracy. Table1 gives Maze15 FLM 95.9% versus the best discrete 52.6% at N=1, and Maze20 FLM 71.4% versus 35.6%, gains of 43.3 and 35.8 percentage points. At N=64 on Maze15, the smallest tested FLM exceeding95% has 88.25M parameters versus 139.00M for MDLM, a 36.51% reduction among tested capacities. Neither result is universal: Maze10 at N=2 favors SEDD-entropy 99.7 over FLM 99.5; Maze20 at N=128 favors MDLM-confidence 94.7 over FLM 92.6. Small Maze10/20 models are overtaken by MDLM at larger budgets. Sudoku's best discrete competitors trail FLM only slightly or tie at N=1/2 and generally lead from N=16 onward; at 64 steps the Extreme/Standard scores are 60.2/64.1 versus FLM 43.9/50.5. Main task tables do not report training-seed variability or confidence intervals, so the small Sudoku margins are especially uncertain. Table1 and Table9 give ten different Maze10 59.11M MDLM values without a clear run/checkpoint explanation; both series are preserved rather than silently reconciled.

Compute accounting is a material qualification. Appendices D2.2/D5 state FLM uses exactly N neural evaluations, standard discrete implementations N+1 including terminal noise removal, and confidence remasking uses 2 calls at N=1 and 128 at N=64. Thus equal nominal steps are not equal denoiser evaluations, FLOPs or runtime. The FLM advantage despite fewer calls can still be useful, but it is not a cost-matched causal comparison. The single-step result also cannot be attributed to information accumulated over multiple previous predictions. Maze FLM training uses 1000 epochs versus 2000 for discrete baselines, not equal training compute; objective, noise and decoding differences remain. Table10 measures sampler-only GPU time on one A10080GB, batch1 and 32 shared instances, without dispersion, excluding data and scoring. Some baseline timings use random weights, and AR CoT uses fixed generation lengths with EOS stopping disabled. FLM is fastest in the reported N=1 measurements, but is not uniformly fastest at N=64.

Mechanistic evidence is informative but bounded. Figure3 reports 23.8% accumulated candidate retention versus 4.9% instantaneous at t=.8, an association rather than a usefulness test. Figure4 selects comeback cells whose correct digit is initially ranked second: deleting it with Top1 hurts recovery. Digit-soft feasible-candidate controls and renormalized/unrenormalized variants are helpful, yet the selected cell cohort and unequal perturbation magnitudes do not establish an unconfounded full-puzzle causal effect or exclude every off-distribution artifact. Table3's matched local decoders show raw-minus-hard path F1 peaking at .2151 at k=4, with raw worse at k=0/1 and nearly equal late. Three seeds concern the probes, not the main trained-model result; no table dispersion or population-optimal decoding is established. The printed k=6 difference .0024 versus .9158-.9135=.0023 is compatible with underlying-value rounding and is not treated as a substantive contradiction.

AppendixD3 more directly intervenes on correct retained candidates: 232/261 original and 47/48 additional cases have positive margin response. Problem-clustered bootstrap intervals are supplied, a strength, but one additional group has only five candidates and the outcome is a next-prediction margin rather than final task success. Signed Q/K/V/residual integrals must not be read as nonnegative shares; a small K mean is not proof that keys are unused. Dataset generation and deduplication are fairly explicit for tree mazes. Sudoku Extreme uses a contiguous one-million/one-thousand/one-thousand split; the exact Standard test subset and a cross-source overlap audit are unclear. Related HRM/TRM puzzle reasoners are discussed but not quantitatively compared. No author implementation, checkpoint or raw experimental output was acquired or executed. The 0.7455 weighted score rewards a well-aligned and experimentally substantial low-step result while discounting incomplete compute normalization, restricted generalization, table inconsistency and limited reproducibility. Source completeness is a multiplier of1, not a scientific-confidence probability.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
本文屬於語言模型方法研究，以字元序列化的迷宮與數獨隔離連續及離散推理狀態。核心貢獻是候選歷史表示、保持硬輸出不變的干預，以及解碼探測的結合；它沒有展示自然語言推理進步，也不是新的流匹配訓練目標。模型從高斯雜訊到one-hot的路徑預測乾淨詞元機率，保留連續狀態，最後才取argmax。

定理1沿實際ODE軌跡使用積分因子，得到0<t<1時的Z_t=(1-t)Z_0+t Ebar_t。Ebar_t是完整one-hot序列的凸組合，其瞬時權重來自各詞元邊際機率的乘積。附錄C明確提醒，這不等於保存所有合法完整解的一般聯合分布。因此幾何共存與正注意力權重只表示訊息可及，不能證明一致的路徑搜尋、使用所有候選、推理正確或加速。定理2降低一個嚴格非首位候選時，硬輸出保持不變，並把預測邊際的導數拆為Q/K重加權、V傳遞及其餘介面項；各項可正可負，也能互相抵銷。其振幅一半的緊界限針對固定時間、脈絡和干預路徑。Euler推論需要步長相對勝者差距夠小，並非所有實際取樣步都適用。定理3是含解碼器超額風險的母體未加權BCE界；相同架構和更新次數不保證超額風險相等，也不能直接推出F1界限。

最強實證是少步迷宮。表1在N=1時，Maze15的流模型95.9%對最佳離散基準52.6%，Maze20為71.4%對35.6%，分別高43.3與35.8個百分點。Maze15在N=64達95%門檻，所測最小流模型88.25M，MDLM需139.00M，約少36.51%參數；這僅限已測容量。並非每處都勝出：Maze10在N=2是SEDD-entropy的99.7%高於流模型99.5%，Maze20在N=128是MDLM-confidence的94.7%高於92.6%。較小Maze10與Maze20模型在高步數也會被MDLM超越。數獨在N=1/2只小幅領先最佳離散方法或平手，從N=16起通常落後；N=64的Extreme與Standard最佳離散成績60.2/64.1%，流模型只有43.9/50.5%。主表沒有跨訓練種子變異或信賴區間，小幅領先尤其不確定。表1與表9的Maze10 59.11M MDLM十個數值全部不同，沒有清楚的執行或檢查點對應，本評審保留兩組而不擅自合併。

計算預算是重要限制。附錄D2.2/D5說流模型做N次神經網路求值，一般離散實作含末端去雜訊共N+1次，信心重遮罩在N=1做2次、N=64做128次。因此相同步數不等於相同模型求值、FLOPs或耗時。流模型用較少呼叫仍勝出可能有用，但不是完全等成本的因果比較。單步優勢也不能歸因於多輪過去預測的累積。迷宮訓練為流模型1000期、離散基準2000期，且目標、雜訊及解碼方式不同。表10在單張A10080GB、batch1、32個共同題目測取樣器耗時，沒有變異資訊，排除資料處理與評分；部分基準用隨機權重，AR CoT固定生成長度並關閉EOS提早終止。流模型在所報單步計時最快，但64步不是全面最快。

機制證據有價值但有邊界。圖3在t=.8的歷史保留23.8%對瞬時4.9%，屬關聯而非效用驗證。圖4刻意選出真值原列第二的回復格，Top1刪去真值後恢復率下降。Digit-soft保留可行候選、重正規化與不重正規化等控制有幫助，但特選群體與不同擾動幅度，仍不能確立完整解成功的無混淆因果效果或排除一切分布外干擾。表3相同局部解碼器在k=4的raw-minus-hard路徑F1差達0.2151；raw在k=0/1反較差，晚步近乎相同。三種子指探測器，非主要訓練模型，表中沒有離散程度，也不是母體最優解碼。k=6列出的差0.0024與四位小數相減0.0023，可以由未四捨五入值造成，不列為實質矛盾。

附錄D3直接移除正確但未居首的歷史候選：原始261例中232例、追加48例中47例呈正邊際響應，並提供依題目分群bootstrap區間，是優點；但追加一組只有五例，終點是下一次預測邊際，不是最終解題成功。Q/K/V及剩餘項的帶符號積分不能當成非負比例，K均值小也不代表key沒有作用。樹狀迷宮生成與去重描述較完整，Sudoku Extreme按順序取一百萬訓練及各一千驗證、測試；Standard確切子集與跨來源重疊稽核不明。相關工作雖討論HRM/TRM，卻未與這些專門解題模型量化比較。本次未取得或執行作者實作、檢查點及原始紀錄。加權0.7455肯定高度相關且少步提升大的方法，同時對成本未完全對齊、外推範圍、表格衝突與可重現性扣分。來源完整度乘數1不等於科學可信度百分比。

scope_assessment.reason: The contribution studies token-state language-model training, sampling and representations. Character-serialized mazes and Sudoku are controlled reasoning tests, not a pure vision or domain-only application.

primary_link.title: Efficient Reasoning with Flow Language Models

papers.summary: Flow Language Models (FLMs) have emerged as a continuous-state alternative to discrete diffusion language models, yet the role of their continuous representations in reasoning remains unclear. We investigate this question by comparing the reasoning efficiency of FLMs and discrete diffusion models, measured by solution accuracy under matched denoising steps. Unlike discrete diffusion, which passes categorical states between denoising steps, FLMs evolve a continuous sequence representation throughout denoising and decodes it into discrete tokens only at the end. Our theoretical analysis shows, from a superposition perspective, how information retained in these continuous states can benefit reasoning. Intermediate-state interventions provide further empirical support for this theoretical account, showing that removing information about alternative candidates reduces subsequent solution recovery. Together, these findings show that FLMs allow evidence for multiple candidates to persist and inform subsequent reasoning before a discrete answer is produced. Furthermore, our experiments on maze planning and Sudoku tasks show that FLMs achieve greater reasoning efficiency in the few-step regime: FLMs achieves higher sequence accuracy than discrete diffusion baselines at matched model sizes and small denoising steps. On maze planning tasks, FLMs can also achieve comparable accuracy with smaller models. For example, on Maze15, FLM reaches the 95\% accuracy target at 64 denoising steps with 36.5\% fewer parameters than MDLM. These findings point to continuous state spaces as a promising foundation for reasoning models that require fewer refinement steps.
papers.summary_en: Flow language models retain soft token candidates until final discretization. On one-step Maze15/20 they score 95.9/71.4%, 43.3/35.8 points above the best discrete baseline. Theory and interventions support usable nonwinning information, not a joint distribution of valid solutions. Nominal steps hide unequal model calls; Sudoku and small models often favor discrete methods at larger budgets. Conflicting maze tables, missing training-seed uncertainty and no natural-language tests limit broad efficiency claims. Code was not run.
papers.summary_zh:
流語言模型把候選詞元保留為連續向量，在多次更新後才選出離散答案。本文用迷宮與數獨研究這種表示是否有助於少步推理，並證明理想流軌跡可以拆成初始雜訊與歷次候選的加權混合。這是表示分解，並不代表模型真的保存所有合法解的聯合機率，也沒有保證答案正確。

最有說服力的是迷宮：15×15與20×20迷宮在單步下達95.9%與71.4%完整解正確率，比各自最強離散基準高43.3與35.8個百分點；Maze15在64步達95%門檻時，所測模型可少用約36.5%參數。保留次佳候選的干預與局部解碼器探測，也支持部分尚未成為第一名的訊息確實可被使用。

但「同樣步數」不是同樣模型呼叫數：流模型做N次，多數離散模型另有末次去雜訊，信心重遮罩在64步會做128次。數獨在16步以上常由離散模型勝出，小型迷宮模型也有反轉；表1與表9同一迷宮基準的十個數值不一致。主結果缺跨訓練種子的離散程度，干預只衡量特選格子的恢復，沒有驗證自然語言推理。本次未取得或執行作者程式。適合把它視為少步符號推理與連續候選表示的有力線索，尚不足以推論通用語言模型的實際加速。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Weighted score 0.742. Relevance 0.95: directly addresses language-agent memory, reasoning branches and premise licensing. Novelty 0.72: combines discourse ownership, a DAS causal route and typed Gram features into a commit interface; the invariance and stability mathematics is classical. Rigor 0.64: source-grouped folds, frame/payload controls and frozen-gate interventions are useful, but there are only ten independent conversation clusters, split identities and DAS training details are unavailable, and several significance claims omit numerical intervals. Evidence 0.64: two scales and controls support the tested ownership signal, not general memory safety. Contamination improves only 0.20 percentage points against full Gram, injected-answer adoption ties, and QA utility/high-recall operating points retain trade-offs. Generalizability 0.43: two small models from one family, fixed diagnostics and constructed frames; joint shift reaches 70.16%, direct trace transfer only 31.66%, while 91.10% requires a refitted head. Reproducibility 0.38: prompts, feature equations and environment are described, but the checklist explicitly reports no released implementation or derived data; training hyperparameters and fold identities remain insufficient. Table 3 calls MRR non-percent yet prints 31.08/32.35, an unresolved scale-label inconsistency; reported values are retained without correction.

primary_link.title: Whose Memory Is It? Scope-Aware Commit Rules for Long-Term LLM Memory

papers.summary: Persistent memory allows an LLM agent to carry experience across conversations, but it also turns a local reasoning mistake into a durable one. During deliberation, an agent may consider a plan, simulate a tool result, report another speaker's belief, and then reject all of them. If memory retains only the resulting sentences, those once-useful possibilities can later return as facts. The record is neither fabricated nor irrelevant; it has simply been detached from the context in which it was valid. We identify this missing context as \emph{discourse ownership}: the world, branch, or speaker that licenses a proposition. Our first finding is counterintuitive. Language models already carry a causally active signal for ownership, yet conventional memory interfaces discard it when they convert reasoning into records. We introduce CASK (Causally Anchored Scoping Keys), a commit rule that preserves this signal so that shared-world facts enter durable memory while provisional content remains available only within its original scope. Our second finding is that the most obvious way to preserve the signal---storing the discovered internal coordinates---is unreliable because equivalent representations need not keep the same coordinates. CASK instead preserves the stable relations that express ownership. Controlled long-conversation conflicts and tool-agent traces show that this design improves memory admission and prevents provisional content from contaminating later answers while complementing runtime provenance. The resulting commit boundary lets agents explore more possibilities without granting every intermediate sentence authority over future behavior.
papers.summary_en: CASK gates durable memory by discourse ownership using a causally probed subspace and a 46-feature typed Gram key. It reaches 83.33%/79.82% attachment on two Qwen scales. On conflicting memory, contamination falls only 7.61% to 7.41%, and injected-answer adoption ties at 1.03%. Trace accuracy requires a refitted head; direct transfer is 31.66%. Ten conversations, joint-shift failures and unreleased artifacts limit the evidence. Invariance covers fixed-subspace basis rotations only.
papers.summary_zh:
代理曾考慮某個計畫，不代表計畫已發生；長期記憶若只保存句子，容易把假設、他人信念或已放棄分支當成事實。本文將問題定義為「話語歸屬」，提出CASK：先用隱藏狀態交換找到對歸屬判斷有因果作用的子空間，再以六個固定診斷提示，分別保存該子空間與其補空間的Gram矩陣，加上四個輸出差值，形成46維特徵，控制命題能否進入共享記憶。未通過者仍留在原情境，而非刪除；實際發生的「曾考慮」事件也可另外保留。
在按來源對話隔離的評估中，Qwen2.5的3B與1.5B版本分別達83.33%與79.82%歸屬準確率。3B衝突記憶相較完整Gram基線，污染率由7.61%降至7.41%，F1由35.43升至37.31，但錯誤答案採納率同為1.03%，未過濾記憶的整體問答分數反而較高。這說明前提授權與回答效用必須分開看。
研究只涵蓋十段對話與同系列小模型。工具軌跡的91.10%平衡準確率來自另訓分類頭，直接轉移僅31.66%；同時更換提示與敘述框架也降至70.16%。換基不變性只保證固定子空間內的正交轉換，不能當成換模型後仍穩定的承諾。未公開實作或衍生資料，仍需外部重現。

primary_link.title: Trajectory Abstraction for the Science of Language Agent Behavior

papers.summary: Scientific studies of language agents need behavioral variables that support hypotheses across tasks and models. We formulate this research problem as learning and testing a hierarchy of trajectory abstractions. A concrete recursive procedure first measures role- and phase-indexed events, proposes temporally constrained relations, and tests their stability across conditions. It then constructs episode-level motif variables from selected relations and repeats the analysis on those variables. Explicit measurement functions connect every abstraction level to the original trajectories. Observations and randomized protocol experiments assess the resulting hypotheses, while comparisons between intervention realizations determine whether an abstraction should be retained, refined, or restricted. We derive a finite-depth bound for accepted reductions, identify protocol effects on fixed abstractions, and characterize realization disagreement and composition of abstraction error. A finite-sample test makes projected intervention consistency operational, and constructed examples illustrate motif construction and abstraction refinement. The formulation distinguishes this experimental approach from semantic taxonomies, qualitative theory induction, and behavior-model recovery. It specifies a proposed research procedure for discovering generalizable behavioral hypotheses, with literature-relative novelty assessed separately from model-relative surprise.
papers.summary_en: This proposal builds agent-behavior hypotheses from explicit trajectory measurements and recursively tested motifs. It separates protocol effects from behavioral causality, derives finite-depth and response-consistency bounds, and supplies a finite-sample test. No implementation or empirical evaluation is reported: the examples are constructed. The value is a precise testing discipline; measurement quality, intervention feasibility, sample cost and transfer remain unvalidated.
papers.summary_zh:
語言代理的工具呼叫、反思與交接能否形成跨任務的行為規律？本文主張先把軌跡轉成可重算的測量，再建立與檢驗較高層的行為模式，而不是只替動作分類。程序以角色、階段、指涉對象及可取得時間定義事件，利用受時間限制的圖搜尋提出關係，經跨環境篩選後，把互不重疊的事件組合成模式，例如「發現差異、承諾修正、完成修正」，再以獨立資料確認預測損失與干預反應是否仍被保留。
關鍵是同一抽象操作可能有不同實現：具體說明證據的確認訊息與一句「好」，雖都能被算成一次確認，卻未必造成相同結果。作者證明，兩種實現的反應分布若相距甚遠，任何共同模型都至少承擔該距離一半的最大誤差，並提供有限樣本檢定、固定變數庫的遞迴深度界限及分層誤差合成條件。
這是一份方法論與理論提案，尚未實作或做實證比較；例子是人為設定，沒有任務成功率或跨模型提升可報。其價值在於把抽象的可計算性、資料隔離、干預範圍及未決結論明確化；侷限則是語意編碼、階段對齊、樣本成本與實際干預仍待驗證。隨機分派只能識別所分派協定的效果，不能自動證明下游行為變數具有因果作用。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant Japanese architecture note separating model-selected tool calls from application-owned execution planning. It correctly emphasizes dependencies, resource conflicts and retry identity instead of treating valid JSON or a parallel call batch as a transaction guarantee. The illustrative executor only gathers reads and serializes writes; it does not implement the proposed DAG or durable idempotency. A decrement-shaped stock update is labeled idempotent without supporting deduplication semantics. With no benchmark, fault-injection results or production validation, this is useful design guidance rather than demonstrated safe concurrency or a new research result.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這篇日文架構文章與代理工具執行高度相關，將模型選出的工具呼叫與應用程式負責的執行計畫分開。它正確強調依賴、資源競爭與重試身分，沒有把有效 JSON 或一批並行呼叫視為交易保證。不過範例僅並行讀取、逐一執行寫入，未實作主張的依賴圖或持久化冪等控制；減少庫存式的操作也在沒有去重語義下被標成冪等。文章沒有基準測試、故障注入結果或正式環境驗證，因此適合作為設計提醒，不能當成安全並行已被證明或新的研究成果。

primary_link.title: LLMのツール呼び出しをどこまで並列化するか

radar.summary:
This Japanese architecture article asks whether an application can safely execute tool calls together, rather than merely whether a model can emit several calls at once. It separates tool selection from execution order: independent reads can run concurrently, while writes require checks of dependencies, target resources and retry semantics. Valid JSON arguments establish structure, not transactional consistency between order creation and inventory updates.

A timeout-and-retry example illustrates duplicate orders. The proposed design assigns a stable idempotency key to a logical operation before invoking the LLM, then uses a dependency graph to release executable nodes. The small Python example only gathers reads and awaits writes one by one. The author acknowledges that it still trusts input-array order and is not a complete scheduler. Writes may also run concurrently when a lower service provides an atomic transaction or the application guarantees nonconflict.

The article is a useful executor-design checklist, not a validated safety or speed solution. Its stock-decrement example is labeled idempotent without durable deduplication, and results do not retain tool-call identifiers. Authorization, locking, error handling and fault tests remain necessary. No benchmark or production measurements are provided; the illustrations are conceptual and cannot establish a reliability gain.
radar.summary_zh:
這篇日文架構文章問的不是模型能否一次產生多個工具呼叫，而是應用程式能否安全地同時執行它們。作者將選擇工具與安排執行順序分開：彼此獨立的唯讀操作可並行；寫入則須檢查依賴、目標資源與重試語義。有效的 JSON 參數只能說明格式，無法保證訂單建立與庫存更新具備交易一致性。

文章用逾時後重試可能重複建立訂單說明風險，提出由應用程式先建立同一邏輯操作的冪等鍵，再以依賴圖解鎖可執行節點。簡化的 Python 範例只把讀取交給 gather，寫入逐一等待；作者也承認這仍依賴輸入陣列的順序，沒有真正完成排程器。若下層服務提供原子交易，或應用程式能保證寫入互不衝突，寫入也可以並行。

它適合當作代理執行器的設計檢查表，並非安全性或速度已經驗證的方案。範例中的庫存遞減被標為冪等，卻沒有持久化去重；結果也未保留工具呼叫識別碼。實務採用時仍需補上權限、鎖定、錯誤處理與故障測試。文章沒有基準測試或正式環境數據，插圖也只是概念呈現，不能據此推論可靠性改善幅度。

links.title: LLM APIのリトライ・タイムアウト・レート制限を実装する実践ガイド

evidence: https://qiita.com/hono_ai_labho/items/2560290ec993ec7be189 | section まず失敗を分類する, source characters [471,902): distinguishes transient transport/server failures from authentication and input failures, and discusses duplicate billing or external effects when retrying. This is an engineering tutorial, not a reported research study.

https://qiita.com/hono_ai_labho/items/2560290ec993ec7be189 | sections タイムアウトは接続と読み取りを分ける and 指数バックオフとジッターでリトライする, [902,4272): sets fixed HTTPX phase timeouts and a 90-second deadline checked before attempts; no remaining-budget request timeout or post-success deadline check is present. An isolated fake-clock test returns success at 95.5 seconds after response durations of 55 and 40 seconds plus a 0.5-second wait.

https://qiita.com/hono_ai_labho/items/2560290ec993ec7be189 | section 指数バックオフとジッターでリトライする, [1598,4272): Retry-After is parsed only with float(); a valid HTTP-date takes the one-second fallback. With three retries, four failed HTTP attempts also perform a final unnecessary wait. These were checked locally using a fake transport and clock.

https://qiita.com/hono_ai_labho/items/2560290ec993ec7be189 | section クライアント側でもレート制限する, [4272,5496), and the embedded Mermaid flowchart in the preceding failure-classification section: code acquires the bucket once outside request(), whereas the diagram loops retries back through rate limiting. A deterministic local check makes four HTTP attempts while consuming one bucket token. The article explicitly notes that in-memory state cannot coordinate multiple processes or hosts.

https://qiita.com/hono_ai_labho/items/2560290ec993ec7be189 | section ログと検証ポイント, [5496,6268): displays assertions for 503/503/200 and immediate 401 failure, but mock_server and call_llm definitions are absent; no complete test output, benchmark or measured reliability improvement is provided. Independent local checks of the actual visible class confirm these two branches; this does not reproduce an unpublished author suite.

HTTPX official timeout documentation, Fine tuning the configuration: read timeout is a per-chunk wait, not a total call deadline (https://www.python-httpx.org/advanced/timeouts/). RFC 9110 section 10.2.3 permits either HTTP-date or delay-seconds for Retry-After (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#section-10.2.3). These primary references corroborate the identified implementation limitations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Relevant to LLM application serving and reliability engineering, but this is a practical blog tutorial rather than peer-reviewed research or a new LLM method. Error classification, bounded retries, jitter, idempotency cautions, and a local token bucket are useful established ideas. The author reports informal mock testing without a complete fixture, helper implementation, measured reliability gains, baselines, load study, or uncertainty. Independent isolated checks confirm the displayed success/error branches but expose material gaps: a successful call can return after the claimed 90-second overall deadline; Retry-After HTTP-date values fall back to one second; and retries bypass the separately acquired token bucket despite the flowchart returning through it. Exhausted HTTP-error retries also sleep after the final attempt. The readable code supports reproduction of these control-flow checks, not production reliability claims. Research novelty and evidential rigor are low, and the example needs corrections before operational reuse.

The author reports informal mock testing without a complete fixture, helper implementation, measured reliability gains, baselines, load study, or uncertainty. Independent isolated checks confirm the displayed success/error branches but expose material gaps: a successful call can return after the claimed 90-second overall deadline; Retry-After HTTP-date values fall back to one second; and retries bypass the separately acquired token bucket despite the flowchart returning through it. Exhausted HTTP-error retries also sleep after the final attempt. The readable code supports reproduction of these control-flow checks, not production reliability claims. Research novelty and evidential rigor are low, and the example needs corrections before operational reuse.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文涉及大型語言模型應用的服務與可靠性工程，但屬實務部落格教學，並非同儕審查研究，也沒有提出新的語言模型方法。錯誤分類、有上限的重試、隨機抖動、冪等性提醒及本機令牌桶，都是有用的既有做法。作者只描述非正式模擬測試，未提供完整測試夾具、輔助函式、可靠性改善量測、基準比較、負載研究或誤差估計。獨立隔離檢查確認所示成功與失敗分支，但也發現重要缺陷：成功呼叫可能在宣稱的 90 秒總期限後才回傳；Retry-After 的 HTTP 日期格式會退回等待一秒；重試不會重新取得令牌，與流程圖返回限流步驟不一致。HTTP 錯誤的最後一次嘗試耗盡後還會多等待一次。程式可讀性有助重現這些控制流程檢查，卻不能證明生產環境可靠性。因此，研究新穎性與證據嚴謹度偏低，實際採用前需要修正範例。

primary_link.title: LLM APIのリトライ・タイムアウト・レート制限を実装する実践ガイド

radar.summary: This implementation tutorial outlines reliability measures for calling LLM APIs: distinguishing temporary failures from authentication or input errors, configuring connection and read/write timeouts, retrying with exponential backoff and jitter, and limiting request frequency with a local token bucket. It also warns that resubmission can duplicate charges or external effects and recommends logging attempts, waiting time, and failure reasons without exposing keys or full prompts. Its evidence consists mainly of code fragments and informal accounts of mock testing, without a complete test environment, performance measurements, or reliability comparisons. Independent offline checks find that the overall deadline is checked only between attempts and cannot prevent a request from returning success after expiry. A server waiting header in date format is not parsed correctly. The token bucket is acquired only before the whole application call, so internal retries do not pass through it again, contrary to the flowchart; an extra wait can also follow the last failure. These are control-flow checks, not measurements of a real provider. Read the article as a reliability checklist, but correct deadline handling, waiting-header parsing, and per-attempt rate limiting, and supply executable tests before assessing production use. Multiple processes and hosts also require shared rate-limit state rather than relying directly on the in-memory implementation.
radar.summary_zh: 這篇實作教學整理呼叫大型語言模型 API 時的可靠性設計，包括區分暫時故障與認證或輸入錯誤、設定連線及讀寫逾時、以指數退避加隨機抖動重試，以及使用本機令牌桶限制請求頻率。作者也提醒重送可能造成重複計費或外部副作用，並建議記錄嘗試次數、等待時間與失敗原因，避免洩漏金鑰與完整提示。其證據主要是程式片段與非正式模擬測試敘述，沒有完整測試環境、效能量測或可靠性比較。獨立離線檢查發現，總期限只在嘗試之間檢查，無法阻止請求超時後仍回傳成功；服務端等待標頭若採日期格式，程式也未正確解析。令牌桶只在整個呼叫前取得一次，內部重試不會再次限流，與流程圖不一致；最後一次失敗後還可能多做等待。這些是程式控制流程的檢查結果，並非真實供應商測速。閱讀時可把本文當成可靠性設計清單，但應先修正期限控制、等待標頭處理及逐次限流，補齊可執行的測試，再評估生產使用。多程序與跨主機情境亦需共享限流狀態，不能直接依賴本機記憶體實作。

primary_link.title: じゃあSonnet5で回していたタスクはどのモデルに変えればいいの？Sonnet5.5なの？Haiku5.5なの？effortは？どれに変えればいいの？？

radar.summary: The article asks which model and effort setting can replace existing automated tasks while preserving quality and reducing cost. The author reconstructs scores and costs from vendor webpage SVG points, chooses the cheapest replacement that reaches the old setting’s score on the same benchmark, and then tests eight CLI configurations on fixed news input. In the personal summarization workflow, the baseline cost is $0.36 and Haiku at medium effort costs about $0.018, a roughly 20-fold cost ratio. Each condition was run only once and quality was checked subjectively, so this does not demonstrate equivalent quality. All seven images were inspected; some graph arrows and text tables choose different replacements, conflicting with the stated uniform minimum-cost rule. Two Sonnet runs ended with API errors, and Haiku at low effort changed a hostname, so costs must be interpreted alongside failures and correction effort. The article acknowledges cross-page cost differences and that API dollars do not directly represent subscription allowance. Full extraction code, calibration data, fixed inputs and outputs are unavailable, and there are no repeated trials or independent quality ratings. Its strongest contribution is a reminder to fix inputs, verify the actual model and measure one’s own tasks. Vendor benchmarks and a single-run case are starting points for testing, not grounds for directly following the table or expecting universal savings.
radar.summary_zh: 這篇文章問的是：既有自動化任務改用哪個模型與投入程度，才能在維持品質的同時降低成本？作者把廠商網頁的 SVG 圖點還原成分數與成本，採用同一基準上分數不低於原設定、且成本最低的替代規則，再以固定新聞輸入測試八種命令列設定。個人摘要流程中，基準成本為零點三六美元，Haiku 中等投入約零點零一八美元，形成約二十倍的成本比；但每種條件只執行一次，品質由作者主觀檢查，不能當作品質等價的證明。七張圖片都已檢視，發現部分圖中箭頭與文字表格選擇不同替代模型，違反文章宣稱的一致最低成本規則。兩次 Sonnet 執行最終出現 API 錯誤，Haiku 低投入也改寫一個主機名稱，顯示成本比較必須連同失敗與修正負擔解讀。文章坦承跨頁成本有差異，且 API 美元不能直接代表訂閱額度。完整擷取程式、校準資料、固定輸入與輸出未提供，也沒有重複試驗或獨立品質評分。因此，它最有價值的是提醒讀者固定輸入、驗證實際模型並量測自己的任務；廠商基準與單次案例只適合作為測試起點，不宜直接照表遷移或預期普遍節省。

radar.summary: This nRouter-team introduction targets developers migrating LLM gateways from OpenRouter, OpenAI or Portkey. Its central step is to replace the endpoint and API key in an OpenAI-compatible client. The platform manages provider credentials, so existing bring-your-own-key arrangements cannot simply be retained. The closing checklist adds two important tasks: map model identifiers to the nRouter catalogue and parallel-run a traffic slice before cutover. These caveats better reflect migration needs than the two-line framing. The example only initializes clients: its static syntax parses, but it supplies no inference request, response, error-handling test or compatibility measurement. All-plan feature inclusion, no migration charge and lower platform fees remain vendor claims; the linked guide even describes OpenRouter credit-purchase charges as per-call fees, requiring comparison with the official billing explanation. No new model method, benchmark, ablation or measured saving is reported. The article provides a starting checklist, not a guarantee that streaming, tool calls, policies or model behavior remain unchanged. Actual workloads and current capabilities and charges need checking before adoption. Reading covers the currently captured full article; historical versions and service performance remain unverified.

primary_link.title: LLMアプリに人間の承認フローを組み込む：自動処理とレビューを組み合わせる設計パターン

radar.summary: This article addresses the gap between generating an LLM action proposal and safely executing consequential operations. It separates proposal from execution: store the action, arguments and reason, then let the server enforce approval-state requirements. A Python/FastAPI in-memory example distinguishes pending, approved, rejected, executed and failed states and illustrates routing by action risk, recipient and content. Its practical value is locating human decision points within tool-use workflows rather than letting the model declare an action safe. Evidence consists only of snippets and operating steps: model output is fixed, email sending only prints, and no real model, mail service or deployment test is provided. The minimal code lacks authentication, atomic transitions and idempotency, so it does not establish protection against concurrent duplicate execution. Content hashes, authorization, idempotency, expiry and audit records are recommended production additions, not existing guarantees. Readers can reuse the architectural separation and responsibility boundaries, but should not treat the tutorial as experimental evidence of safety or efficiency gains. All nodes, labels and transitions in the embedded state diagram were checked; rendered pixels and historical-version completeness were not verified.
radar.summary_zh: 本文處理 LLM 能產生行動建議，卻不宜直接執行高影響操作的問題，提出把「提案」與「執行」分開：先保存動作、參數與理由，再由伺服器依核准狀態決定能否執行。範例以 Python 與 FastAPI 建立記憶體內的流程，區分待核准、已核准、已拒絕、已執行與失敗，並示意依動作風險、收件者及內容決定是否需要人工審查。其實務價值是把人工決策點放進工具使用流程，而不是讓模型自行宣告安全。證據僅為程式片段與操作步驟；模型輸出固定，寄信只列印訊息，沒有真實模型、郵件服務或部署測試。最小程式也未實作身分驗證、原子狀態轉移與冪等性，因此不能據此認定已防止並行重複執行。文章把內容雜湊、授權、冪等性、有效期限及稽核紀錄列為正式運作時應補上的措施，這些建議不能視為既有保證。閱讀時可借用其架構分層與責任邊界，但不應將教學當成安全性或效率改善的實驗證明。內嵌狀態圖的完整節點、標籤與轉移已核對，未驗證其像素呈現；歷史版本完整性仍未確認。

However, evidence is one eight-sentence PR description plus the author’s own 47-sentence draft, with subjective decisions, no annotated test set, baseline, threshold calibration, repeated trials, or independent readers. Of 26 draft candidates, only six were edited; the other 20 included nine quoted examples and 11 author-judged acceptable cases. This is review workload, not measured detector precision. Claude rewriting and a second AI’s comprehension check also prevent attributing improvements to Jev alone. Missing full scripts, prompts and model settings limit reproduction. Useful as a narrow human-reviewed linting recipe, with modest novelty and weak evidence of general benefit.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文與日語大型語言模型寫作流程高度相關，但不是辨識人工智慧作者身分的工具，也不是經驗證的研究基準。六類提問及明確門檻使做法可供檢視，成對的拉取請求範例也呈現作者如何修改。然而，證據僅來自一份八句的說明與作者自己的四十七句草稿；判斷主觀，缺少標註測試集、基準方法、門檻校準、重複試驗及獨立讀者。草稿的二十六項候選中只有六句被修改，其餘二十項包括九項引用範例與十一項作者認為無問題的內容；這反映人工複核負擔，不能當成偵測精確率。Claude 改寫及另一個人工智慧的理解檢查也使改善無法單獨歸因於 Jev。完整程式、提示與模型設定未公開，限制重現。可作為狹窄情境下由人複核的文字檢查配方，但新穎性有限，普遍效益的證據薄弱。

primary_link.title: Jevを使ってAI臭い文章を判定するようにした結果

radar.summary: This practitioner article addresses vague metaphors, missing agents and unnatural collocations in Japanese generated text. Its aim is to flag sentences for rereading, not determine AI authorship. The author supplies paragraph context for each sentence, asks Jev six types of style question, and flags candidates using thresholds from 0.35 to 0.5. Claude then rewrites them, while another AI checks comprehension difficulties. Six of eight sentences in a pull-request description were flagged; examples replace vague mouth and footprint metaphors with concrete process and log descriptions and add explicit subjects. The author’s own 47-sentence draft produced 26 candidates, but only six sentences were edited. Nine remaining candidates were quoted examples and 11 were judged acceptable by the author. Candidates therefore still need human review, and the edited fraction is not detector precision. The article acknowledges missed headings and excessive token consumption when checking every response. It offers a reusable proofreading workflow, but no independent annotations, baseline comparisons, threshold calibration or repeated experiments, and omits the full script and model settings. The examples support this author’s limited experience, not a general improvement, reliable AI-text detection or performance equivalence with another service.
radar.summary_zh: 這篇實務文章處理日語生成文字中的含糊比喻、缺漏主體與不自然搭配，目標是找出需要重讀的句子，而非判定文章是否由人工智慧撰寫。作者逐句提供段落脈絡，讓 Jev 回答六類風格問題，依零點三五至零點五的門檻標示候選，再由 Claude 改寫，並請另一個人工智慧檢查理解困難。拉取請求說明的八句中有六句被標示，範例展示把「口」與「足跡」換成具體處理及記錄，並補上主詞。作者自己的四十七句草稿產生二十六項候選，但只修改六句；其餘九項是引用範例，十一項被作者認為沒有問題。這顯示候選仍需人工複核，不能把修改比例當成偵測精確率。文章也坦承標題漏檢，以及全面檢查導致代幣消耗過高。它提供可借鑑的寫作檢查流程，卻沒有獨立標註、基準比較、門檻校準或重複實驗；完整腳本與模型設定亦未交代。因此，案例只能支持此作者的局部使用經驗，不能證明普遍改善、可靠辨識人工智慧文本，或與其他服務具有效能等價性。

links.title: Reading Your LLM Gateway Invoice: Credits, Fees & Governance

evidence: The fee line, source.txt Unicode [419,674), https://qiita.com/nrouter_ai1991/items/870c06809a867667707f#the-fee-line: stated fee schedules imply $5.80 versus $5.20 for $5 credits, and $105.50 versus $104.00 for $100 credits; these are calculated examples, not measured savings.

The governance line, source.txt Unicode [674,896), https://qiita.com/nrouter_ai1991/items/870c06809a867667707f#the-governance-line: bundled governance and competitor-absence statements are vendor assertions with no test protocol or outcome data.

The migration line, source.txt Unicode [896,1155), https://qiita.com/nrouter_ai1991/items/870c06809a867667707f#the-migration-line: an OpenAI client initialization illustrates endpoint/key replacement and explicitly separates policy mapping; no API execution or migration trial is reported.

The stay line, source.txt Unicode [1155,1445), https://qiita.com/nrouter_ai1991/items/870c06809a867667707f#the-stay-line: acknowledges negotiated BYOK rates, catalogue breadth and discovery as reasons to remain with OpenRouter.

Supplemental vendor comparison, Side-by-side feature gating / What OpenRouter does better, https://nrouter.ai/blog/product/openrouter-alternative: explicitly identifies the matrix as sales collateral; its inspected Figure 1 asset is a promotional cover, not a results plot. The HTML table and caveats were read as claims, not independent validation.

Supplemental primary competitor check, pricing plan comparison / Budgets & Spend Controls / Admin Controls, https://openrouter.ai/pricing: retrieved October 8 after the collection cutoff; Standard and higher columns list these controls. This limits the blanket absence claim, without establishing exact feature parity or a historical snapshot.
llm_evaluation.rationale: This vendor-authored billing explainer is relevant to LLM serving costs and governance, but offers no new learning method or experimental research. The two top-up examples are arithmetically correct under the stated fee assumptions; no workload, invoices, uncertainty analysis, or measured governance outcomes are supplied. Its blanket competitor comparison is not established: the linked sales matrix is not independent evidence, and current OpenRouter pricing lists budgets/spend controls and admin controls. Policy-mapping and BYOK caveats are useful operational context, while live compatibility, feature parity, and current minimum fees remain unverified.

The two top-up examples are arithmetically correct under the stated fee assumptions; no workload, invoices, uncertainty analysis, or measured governance outcomes are supplied. Its blanket competitor comparison is not established: the linked sales matrix is not independent evidence, and current OpenRouter pricing lists budgets/spend controls and admin controls. Policy-mapping and BYOK caveats are useful operational context, while live compatibility, feature parity, and current minimum fees remain unverified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這篇供應商撰寫的帳務說明與大型語言模型的服務成本及治理相關，但沒有新的學習方法或實驗研究。兩個儲值例子的算術在文中費率假設下正確，卻未提供工作負載、實際帳單、不確定性分析或治理成效量測。對競品的一概比較缺乏證實：連結中的銷售比較表不是獨立證據，而目前 OpenRouter 定價頁列有預算、支出及管理控制。政策對應與自備金鑰的限制具操作參考價值；實際相容性、功能等同性及目前最低費用仍未驗證。

primary_link.title: Reading Your LLM Gateway Invoice: Credits, Fees & Governance

radar.summary: This article separates token usage, platform charges and minimum fees in LLM gateway invoices, using nRouter and OpenRouter to illustrate small top-ups. Under the author’s fee assumptions, five dollars of credits cost $5.20 and $5.80 respectively; one hundred dollars cost $104 and $105.50. The arithmetic can be reproduced, but these are conditional examples rather than measured workload savings. Changing an endpoint and key does not automatically transfer quotas, alerts, permissions or cost attribution. Negotiated BYOK rates, model catalogues and public discovery tools can matter more than the fee difference. Research evidence is limited: no new model method, experiment, benchmark, ablation or actual invoice is supplied, and the linked feature table comes from the same vendor. Current OpenRouter pricing lists budget, spending and administrative controls, so the absence of competitor governance is not established; this also does not establish equivalent features. The article is useful as a fee and migration-policy checklist, but current charges, capabilities and compatibility need checking before procurement. Complete reading here covers the currently captured short article, not recovered historical bytes or validated service performance.
radar.summary_zh: 本文從 LLM 閘道帳單出發，將權杖用量、平台費與最低費用分開，並以 nRouter 與 OpenRouter 說明小額儲值的影響。按作者列出的費率，購買五美元額度時總額分別為五點二與五點八美元；購買一百美元額度則為一百零四與一百零五點五美元。算術可重算，但這些是條件式例子，並非實際工作負載的節省結果。文章也提醒，切換端點與金鑰不會自動搬移配額、告警、權限和成本歸屬；自備金鑰的議價、模型目錄與公開探索工具都可能比手續費更重要。研究證據相當有限：沒有新模型方法、實驗、基準、消融或真實帳單，連結的功能表也由同一供應商製作。另查目前 OpenRouter 官方定價頁，可見預算、支出及管理控制，因此不能把競品完全缺乏治理當成已證實事實，也不能據此推論兩者功能完全相同。本文適合作為核對費率與遷移政策的清單；採購前仍須確認現行費用、功能與相容性。此次完整閱讀的是目前擷取的短文，不代表已找回歷史版本或驗證服務表現。

links.title: 🔓2026年9〜10月の情報漏洩19件、公表文を全部読んで考えたこと

evidence: Article section はじめに (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#%E3%81%AF%E3%81%98%E3%82%81%E3%81%AB): The author selects 19 announcements by impact or familiarity, includes follow-ups, uses an October 6 information cutoff and explicitly disclaims statistical representativeness.

Article section 何が起きたか (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#%E4%BD%95%E3%81%8C%E8%B5%B7%E3%81%8D%E3%81%9F%E3%81%8B): Table 1 contains 19 data rows in heterogeneous units, including possible leaks, people, accounts and sent spoof emails. Six rows explicitly name vulnerabilities and two name unauthorized logins; totals across these units would be invalid.

Article section 19件から見えたパターン (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#19%E4%BB%B6%E3%81%8B%E3%82%89%E8%A6%8B%E3%81%88%E3%81%9F%E3%83%91%E3%82%BF%E3%83%BC%E3%83%B3): Five qualitative patterns concern vulnerabilities, lateral spread, external detection, retained/deleted data and third-party services. This is a narrative classification, not an experiment or evidence of AI involvement.

Article section AIで何が変わったか (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#ai%E3%81%A7%E4%BD%95%E3%81%8C%E5%A4%89%E3%82%8F%E3%81%A3%E3%81%9F%E3%81%8B): Table 2 attributes exploit development, simulated harmful-request engagement and cost claims to external sources. The paragraph labels the cost interpretation as the author’s conjecture and acknowledges the vendor relationship.

Article section 直っても、更新しないと届かない (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#%E7%9B%B4%E3%81%A3%E3%81%A6%E3%82%82%E3%80%81%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E3%81%97%E3%81%AA%E3%81%84%E3%81%A8%E5%B1%8A%E3%81%8B%E3%81%AA%E3%81%84): Patch distribution, EOL systems and pre-patch exploitation motivate layered defenses; this section does not measure whether proposed controls would have prevented the 19 incidents.

Article section 対策 (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#%E5%AF%BE%E7%AD%96): Table 3 maps three policy groups to five patterns, followed by developer, organization and user checklists. The article distinguishes some reference advice as based on cases outside its 19-event sample.

Article section おわりに (https://zenn.dev/bita/articles/1616afdb93c4a6#%E3%81%8A%E3%82%8F%E3%82%8A%E3%81%AB): The final paragraph explicitly says causality between the 19 incidents and AI is unknown; its cheaper-discovery explanation remains an interpretation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A Japanese practitioner blog with useful, limited relevance to LLM-enabled cyber risk. It separates a purposive 19-disclosure incident summary from outside AI-capability reports and expressly declines a causal link between AI and these incidents. Reading all three tables supports the six vulnerability and two unauthorized-login rows, but neither this convenience sample nor zero public mentions of AI estimates actual AI involvement. The practical advice on patchability, segmentation, identity controls and retention is sensible synthesis rather than a new language-model method or evaluated defense. Primary-source spot checks support the quoted Anthropic exploit counts and Digital Agency incident details; the former are sandboxed vendor evaluations, with harmful-task engagement measured in a simulated environment, not attack success against these organizations. The absence of systematic selection, independent coding, incident-level AI attribution and comparative defense outcomes limits novelty, rigor and generalization. The supplied blog is sufficient for a bounded review; uncrosschecked external disclosures are an evidence limitation, not a missing article-body hold. No scope cap is applied, but its mainly general-security content reduces topical relevance.

It separates a purposive 19-disclosure incident summary from outside AI-capability reports and expressly declines a causal link between AI and these incidents. Reading all three tables supports the six vulnerability and two unauthorized-login rows, but neither this convenience sample nor zero public mentions of AI estimates actual AI involvement. The practical advice on patchability, segmentation, identity controls and retention is sensible synthesis rather than a new language-model method or evaluated defense. Primary-source spot checks support the quoted Anthropic exploit counts and Digital Agency incident details; the former are sandboxed vendor evaluations, with harmful-task engagement measured in a simulated environment, not attack success against these organizations. The absence of systematic selection, independent coding, incident-level AI attribution and comparative defense outcomes limits novelty, rigor and generalization. The supplied blog is sufficient for a bounded review; uncrosschecked external disclosures are an evidence limitation, not a missing article-body hold. No scope cap is applied, but its mainly general-security content reduces topical relevance.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這是一篇日本工程實務部落格，對語言模型帶來的網路風險具有有限而實用的關聯。作者把目的性選取的十九起公告整理與外部人工智慧能力報告分開，並明確表示無法判定這些事件與人工智慧的因果關係。完整閱讀三張表後，可核對六筆漏洞與兩筆不當登入紀錄；但便利樣本及公告零次提及人工智慧，都不能估計實際參與程度。更新能力、網路分隔、身分控制與資料保存等建議屬實務綜整，並非新語言模型方法或經評估的防禦。主要來源抽查支持文中引用的 Anthropic 漏洞利用次數及日本數位廳事件細節；前者是廠商的沙箱測試，其中惡意任務參與率來自模擬環境，不能當成對這些組織的攻擊成功率。缺少系統性取樣、獨立編碼、事件層級人工智慧歸因及防禦比較結果，限制新穎性、嚴謹度與外推。現有文章足以完成有界評估；尚未逐一交叉核對的公告是證據限制，而非文章缺件。未套用領域上限，但以一般資安為主的內容降低主題相關度。

primary_link.title: 🔓2026年9〜10月の情報漏洩19件、公表文を全部読んで考えたこと

radar.summary: This Japanese practitioner blog summarizes nineteen unauthorized-access and data-leak disclosures, including follow-ups, published from September 11 to October 5. It asks whether AI has changed attack techniques or reduced the cost of finding old vulnerabilities. Cases were selected by impact or name recognition, and the author explicitly disclaims statistical representativeness. Six entries mention vulnerabilities and two mention unauthorized logins, but the absence of AI mentions does not establish that attackers did not use AI. Read the incident table and five patterns first, then the separately cited model-capability reports, without joining these two bodies of evidence into a causal chain. The cited sandbox exploit tests and simulated harmful-task engagement rates describe capability under particular conditions; they cannot directly explain these nineteen incidents. Practical priorities are keeping systems updateable, continuously checking code and configuration, and limiting damage through privilege separation, multifactor authentication, logging, backups and data minimization. Impact figures mix people, accounts, records and sent emails, sometimes describing only possible exposure, so they should not be added together. The article is useful for reviewing defensive questions and tracing original announcements. It is neither a new language-model method, a study of AI-attack prevalence nor experimental proof that the proposed defenses work. The author explicitly preserves uncertainty about a causal connection between these incidents and AI.
radar.summary_zh: 這篇日本實務部落格整理九月十一日至十月五日公表、包含續報的十九起不當存取與資料外洩事件，追問人工智慧究竟改變了攻擊手法，還是降低了發現舊漏洞的成本。作者依影響規模或知名度選案，明示樣本不具統計代表性；六筆公告提到漏洞、兩筆提到不當登入，但公告未提及人工智慧，不等於攻擊沒有使用人工智慧。閱讀時先看事件表與五種模式，再看另行引用的模型能力報告，避免把兩套證據混成因果鏈。文中引用的沙箱漏洞利用測試與模擬惡意任務參與率，能說明特定條件下的能力，不能直接解釋這十九起事件。實務重點在維持可更新的系統、持續檢查程式與配置，以及用權限分隔、多因素驗證、紀錄、備份和資料最小化限制損害。影響數字混有人數、帳號、紀錄與寄信次數，且部分只是可能外洩，不宜相加。本文適合用來盤點防禦問題與追查原始公告，並非新語言模型方法、人工智慧攻擊盛行率研究，或防禦措施效果的實驗證明；作者也明確保留這些事件與人工智慧的因果不確定性。
