links.title: AIへの「良い指示」は変わり続ける：実装詳細より文脈と制約を渡す

evidence: https://qiita.com/tonbi_attack/items/08204cc08e2b5b48b09e — はじめに, source.txt [133,447): frames changing instruction quality around agents that can investigate codebases; names no evaluated system or capability study.

https://qiita.com/tonbi_attack/items/08204cc08e2b5b48b09e — 昔は細かく指示することに意味があった [447,683) and 実装詳細を決めずに渡せる場面が増えた [683,1008): contrasts UserService.ts/getUser/sessionStorage instructions with a requirement to isolate search state per tab, investigate impact and add tests. These are illustrative requests, not tested before/after results.

https://qiita.com/tonbi_attack/items/08204cc08e2b5b48b09e — 人間が渡すのは、コードから読み取れない情報 [1008,1527), original HTML table: six information categories, Context, Why, Constraints, Domain Knowledge, Decision and Done, each paired with its meaning. The customer/applicant/contractHolder example concerns business semantics; there is no measured taxonomy or NLP task.

https://qiita.com/tonbi_attack/items/08204cc08e2b5b48b09e — 細かい指示は選択肢を狭めることがある [1527,1758): suggests comparing implementation choices but requires explicit architecture decisions, security requirements and permitted change scope; does not advocate unrestricted autonomy.

https://qiita.com/tonbi_attack/items/08204cc08e2b5b48b09e — 任せることと判断を放棄することは違う [1758,1976): retains human output verification and production/publication decisions; warns against delegating work without tests, reviews, diff inspection and rollback means.

https://qiita.com/tonbi_attack/items/08204cc08e2b5b48b09e — おわりに [1976,2243): advice is explicitly conditional on the current agent’s ability to discover implementation details. Full supplied article [0,2522) supplies no experimental models, sample sizes, outcome statistics, controlled comparisons or evaluation artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to prompting and coding-agent collaboration, this practitioner essay argues that instructions should adapt to an agent’s actual capabilities: delegate code-discoverable implementation choices while specifying context, purpose, constraints, domain knowledge, decisions and completion criteria. A tab-isolated search-state example contrasts prescribed implementation steps with outcome-focused requirements, and the article retains human responsibility for architecture, security, scope, verification and release decisions. These are sensible conditional workflow recommendations with modest novelty, not demonstrated performance gains. No model/version, evaluated repository, executed task trace, dataset, baseline, success rate, time measurement or ablation is supplied. The six-category table is a communication checklist rather than an experimentally validated method. Generalization depends on agent competence, repository accessibility and usable tests; productivity and design-quality claims remain hypotheses. The complete supplied text and original table cells were read. The related-author link is conceptual background, not evidence used to raise scores; historical source identity and original-document completeness remain unverified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這篇實務觀點文章直接關聯提示設計與程式代理協作，主張指令應配合代理的實際能力調整：可由程式庫查明的實作選擇交由代理處理，人類則明示脈絡、目的、限制、領域知識、取捨及完成條件。文中以分頁獨立保存搜尋狀態為例，對照指定實作步驟與描述結果需求的寫法，同時保留人類對架構、安全、範圍、驗證與發布的責任。這些是合理但有條件的工作流程建議，新穎性有限，也未證明效能提升。文章未提供模型或版本、受測程式庫、實際任務紀錄、資料集、基準對照、成功率、時間量測或消融。六類資訊表是溝通清單，並非經實驗驗證的方法。可推廣程度取決於代理能力、程式庫可存取性及可用測試；生產力與設計品質主張仍屬假設。已完整閱讀供應文字及原始表格各儲存格。同作者的相關連結僅屬概念背景，未用來提高評分；歷史來源身分與原始文件完整性仍未核實。

primary_link.title: AIへの「良い指示」は変わり続ける：実装詳細より文脈と制約を渡す

radar.summary: This article asks how instructions should change as coding agents become more capable. Its central recommendation is that, when an agent can inspect a codebase and compare implementations, people should prioritize context, purpose, constraints, domain knowledge, trade-offs and completion criteria rather than prescribing every file and function. A per-tab search-state example contrasts a storage-specific task list with an outcome-focused request that includes impact analysis and tests; a six-category table organizes the information humans should supply. This is communication and delegation advice, with no evaluated model, version, repository, actual task trace, control group, success rate or timing data. It therefore does not establish that fewer implementation details improve quality or productivity. Nor does the author advocate abandoning supervision: architecture, security, change scope and release decisions must remain explicit or under human control, and tests, reviews, diff inspection and rollback means still matter. Practitioners can use the checklist to assess whether requirements are clear and adjust delegation to the agent’s actual competence; less capable agents still need task decomposition. Its value is distinguishing code-discoverable information from human business judgment, not introducing an algorithm or validated prompt-optimization method. The related-article link was not treated as experimental evidence. Supplied text and table content were checked; historical-version completeness remains unverified.
radar.summary_zh: 本文討論程式代理能力改變後，人類應如何調整指令。核心主張是：代理能自行查閱程式庫與比較實作方式時，人類應優先提供脈絡、目的、限制、領域知識、取捨與完成條件，而非預先指定每個檔案和函式。文章以各分頁獨立保存搜尋條件為例，對照指定儲存方式的操作清單與描述目標、影響範圍及測試需求的寫法，並用六類資訊表整理人類應補充的內容。這是一份溝通與分工建議，沒有提供受測模型、版本、程式庫、實際任務紀錄、對照組、成功率或耗時數據，因此尚不能證明較少實作細節會提升品質或生產力。作者也沒有主張放棄監督：架構、安全要求、可修改範圍與發布決策仍須明示或由人類掌握，測試、審查、差異檢查及回復手段不可省略。實務上可把清單用於檢查需求是否清楚，再依代理的真實能力決定委派程度；能力不足時仍需拆解任務。閱讀價值在於區分可從程式碼取得的資訊與只有人類能補足的業務判斷，而非新的演算法或經驗證的提示最佳化方法。相關文章連結未被當成實驗證據；目前僅確認供應文字與表格內容，歷史版本完整性仍未核實。
radar.title: Good Instructions for AI Keep Changing: Provide Context and Constraints Rather Than Implementation Details
radar.title_zh: 給 AI 的「好指令」不斷改變：提供脈絡與限制，而非預先指定實作細節

links.title: Claude Codeが「検証済み」と言ったアプリが、4分後にすぐバグった話

evidence: Section 「録画で確認しました」の 4 分後に落ちた (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E3%80%8C%E9%8C%B2%E7%94%BB%E3%81%A7%E7%A2%BA%E8%AA%8D%E3%81%97%E3%81%BE%E3%81%97%E3%81%9F%E3%80%8D%E3%81%AE-4-%E5%88%86%E5%BE%8C%E3%81%AB%E8%90%BD%E3%81%A1%E3%81%9F): The author reports a 1068 ms initial rendering delay, then five launch-flag transitions recorded at 50 fps with 61–234 ms draws. Commit time is 11:43 and two device crashes are logged at 11:47; these timings are author observations, not new reviewer measurements.

Section 「録画で確認しました」の 4 分後に落ちた (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E3%80%8C%E9%8C%B2%E7%94%BB%E3%81%A7%E7%A2%BA%E8%AA%8D%E3%81%97%E3%81%BE%E3%81%97%E3%81%9F%E3%80%8D%E3%81%AE-4-%E5%88%86%E5%BE%8C%E3%81%AB%E8%90%BD%E3%81%A1%E3%81%9F): Figure 2 visually reproduces masked excerpts of two commits, diagnosing WKWebView creation before UIApplicationMain. It reports failure during UIKit touch delivery and the 11:57 repair, fourteen minutes after the initial commit and ten after the first listed crash.

Section Before / After (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#before-%2F-after): The Before GIF contains launch-flag measurements, a statement that the physical screen was not visible, the user crash report and two .ips filenames at 11:47. It is an edited session replay rather than an original live device recording.

Section Before / After (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#before-%2F-after): The After GIF visibly contains the failing scrolling test and UIKit exception, a passing parent-commit control, three repaired simulator passes and one iPhone pass. This strengthens the local test-sensitivity claim but does not independently authenticate the underlying repository.

Section 同じ形の失敗が、あと 2 つあった (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E5%90%8C%E3%81%98%E5%BD%A2%E3%81%AE%E5%A4%B1%E6%95%97%E3%81%8C%E3%80%81%E3%81%82%E3%81%A8-2-%E3%81%A4%E3%81%82%E3%81%A3%E3%81%9F): Figure 5 shows the deployment Makefile comment and a September 17 terminal snapshot: active service, PID 7959, app.py and process start dated September 14. The separate audit anecdote says new extraction code had no caller and three acceptance journeys were not exercised.

Section どう制御するか (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E3%81%A9%E3%81%86%E5%88%B6%E5%BE%A1%E3%81%99%E3%82%8B%E3%81%8B): Three tables and the Mermaid flowchart map changed user paths to touch-driven tests, process/build checks and real entry-point journeys; commands/output and untested paths are required in the report.

Section 完了条件を「操作の列」で書き、実物で通す (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E5%AE%8C%E4%BA%86%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6%E3%82%92%E3%80%8C%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E3%81%AE%E5%88%97%E3%80%8D%E3%81%A7%E6%9B%B8%E3%81%8D%E3%80%81%E5%AE%9F%E7%89%A9%E3%81%A7%E9%80%9A%E3%81%99): The XCTest snippet opens a list item, swipes up five times/down twice, returns, opens another item and swipes again. The Makefile compares MainPID and prints local/remote source and served-response hashes; it does not itself assert equality of like-for-like build artifacts.

Section 報告に「通していない経路」を書かせ、Stop フックで終わり方に掛ける (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E3%81%AB%E3%80%8C%E9%80%9A%E3%81%97%E3%81%A6%E3%81%84%E3%81%AA%E3%81%84%E7%B5%8C%E8%B7%AF%E3%80%8D%E3%82%92%E6%9B%B8%E3%81%8B%E3%81%9B%E3%80%81stop-%E3%83%95%E3%83%83%E3%82%AF%E3%81%A7%E7%B5%82%E3%82%8F%E3%82%8A%E6%96%B9%E3%81%AB%E6%8E%9B%E3%81%91%E3%82%8B): A completion policy and a Stop-hook gate are described. The article explicitly acknowledges that the gate uses an LLM and can make mistakes; no quantitative gate evaluation is presented here.

Section 限界 (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E9%99%90%E7%95%8C): The author reports resource exhaustion from duplicate test services, retains manual Mac checks, limits iPhone testing to one simulator followed by hardware, and admits that passing swipes do not cover pinch or rotation. Pure functions and documentation changes are stated exceptions.

Section 自分で見直しても抜けられない (https://zenn.dev/ihsan/articles/claude-code-4-10f00163d6d1#%E8%87%AA%E5%88%86%E3%81%A7%E8%A6%8B%E7%9B%B4%E3%81%97%E3%81%A6%E3%82%82%E6%8A%9C%E3%81%91%E3%82%89%E3%82%8C%E3%81%AA%E3%81%84): The reasoning self-correction paper is used as an analogy, and the author explicitly distinguishes its task domain from product verification. It does not directly demonstrate the claimed mechanism in this coding-agent workflow.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant Japanese practitioner case report on coding-agent verification, not a controlled research paper. The strongest evidence is an author-curated bad-commit/parent/fixed-commit comparison: a touch-driven UI test reportedly exposes the crash missed by launch-flag recordings, then passes after repair. Commit excerpts and animated session replays corroborate the narrative at the level of published artifacts, but the repository, original crash files and complete sessions are not available for independent replication. Deployment and audit anecdotes broaden the operational lesson without establishing population rates. The useful contribution is a concrete, falsifiable acceptance-path checklist; it does not prove universal failure of proxy checks or intrinsic self-review.

top5.summary:
This Japanese practitioner report argues that a coding agent’s claim of completed verification should be examined in terms of the user path it actually exercised. The author’s iPhone app was committed after launch-flag transitions, recordings and performance checks, yet crashed on finger scrolling four minutes later. The reported cause was early WebView creation: the recording showed rendered pages without traversing the failing touch-handling path.

The stronger part is the subsequent countercheck. Published commit excerpts and animated session replays show a touch-driven UI test failing on the broken commit, passing on its parent, and passing after repair three times in the simulator and once on hardware. Separate deployment and audit cases illustrate that a running service need not contain the new build, and existing code need not be reachable from the application. The proposed acceptance criteria are sequences of operations, accompanied by output evidence and untested paths.

These are author-selected engineering cases, not a controlled study of agent reliability. The animations are edited replays, and the full repository and original crash records are unavailable for independent reproduction. A changed process ID also does not establish build identity; the actual artifact must be checked. The transferable lesson is to exercise affected paths while choosing checks proportionate to risk and cost. Passing a scrolling test does not establish safety for rotation, pinch or every device, and reasoning self-correction research is not direct causal evidence for this case.
top5.summary_zh:
這篇日文實務紀錄指出，程式代理說「驗證完成」時，必須追問它走過的是哪一條使用路徑。作者的 iPhone 應用程式經啟動旗標切換畫面、錄影與效能檢查後提交，四分鐘後卻在手指捲動時崩潰。問題據報來自過早建立 WebView；錄影看到了已繪製頁面，沒有經過出錯的觸控處理。

較有力的部分是後續反向檢查：作者展示的提交摘錄與工作階段動畫顯示，觸控式 UI 測試在故障提交失敗，在父提交通過，修復後又於模擬器通過三次、實機通過一次。另兩個部署與稽核案例提醒，服務仍在運行不代表新版本已載入，程式碼存在也不代表能從應用程式入口呼叫。文章因此把驗收條件寫成操作序列，要求附上輸出證據及尚未走過的路徑。

這是作者挑選的工程案例，不是代理可靠性的受控研究。公開動畫是刪節重播，沒有完整儲存庫與原始崩潰紀錄可供獨立重現；程序識別碼改變也不足以證明版本正確，仍須核對實際產物。可採用的是讓測試真正經過受影響路徑的原則，同時依風險控制成本。通過捲動測試不代表旋轉、縮放或所有裝置都安全，也不能把推理自我修正的研究直接當成此案例的因果證據。

evidence: Section 手元で確認したこと (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E6%89%8B%E5%85%83%E3%81%A7%E7%A2%BA%E8%AA%8D%E3%81%97%E3%81%9F%E3%81%93%E3%81%A8): The author scans three projects: H14 yields zero detections and H17 flags two module-initialized constants, acknowledged false positives. The subtitle pipeline logs only its first chunk, so its zero read counter does not establish persistent cache failure.

Section 手元で確認したこと (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E6%89%8B%E5%85%83%E3%81%A7%E7%A2%BA%E8%AA%8D%E3%81%97%E3%81%9F%E3%81%93%E3%81%A8): The reported paired probe uses claude-sonnet-5-5 with low effort: input/write/read/output = 13/1123/0/64 followed by 13/0/1123/64. Both input totals are 1136; this is a single reported demonstration, not independently repeated here.

Section 大前提: プレフィックス一致 (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E5%A4%A7%E5%89%8D%E6%8F%90%3A-%E3%83%97%E3%83%AC%E3%83%95%E3%82%A3%E3%83%83%E3%82%AF%E3%82%B9%E4%B8%80%E8%87%B4): The article organizes caching around the tools → system → messages prefix and explains why variable system content or changing tool definitions invalidate downstream sharing.

Section 原因 3: プロンプトが短すぎる (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E5%8E%9F%E5%9B%A0-3%3A-%E3%83%97%E3%83%AD%E3%83%B3%E3%83%97%E3%83%88%E3%81%8C%E7%9F%AD%E3%81%99%E3%81%8E%E3%82%8B): Table 1 lists minimum lengths of 512, 1024, 2048 and 4096 tokens for specified model groups. These are thresholds, not measured performance results.

Section 原因 4: ブレークポイントの位置が悪い (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E5%8E%9F%E5%9B%A0-4%3A-%E3%83%96%E3%83%AC%E3%83%BC%E3%82%AF%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E3%81%AE%E4%BD%8D%E7%BD%AE%E3%81%8C%E6%82%AA%E3%81%84): The example places an explicit cache marker after shared context and before the varying question. This preserves the reusable prefix rather than assuming that an automatic marker on a varying suffix will create an earlier cache entry.

Section 原因 5: thinking や effort をリクエストごとに変えている (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E5%8E%9F%E5%9B%A0-5%3A-thinking-%E3%82%84-effort-%E3%82%92%E3%83%AA%E3%82%AF%E3%82%A8%E3%82%B9%E3%83%88%E3%81%94%E3%81%A8%E3%81%AB%E5%A4%89%E3%81%88%E3%81%A6%E3%81%84%E3%82%8B): The advice fixes thinking/effort by route. The article recognizes model-dependent invalidation scope, but its parenthetical default-high description should not replace checking the chosen model default.

Section 原因 6: TTL の窓を外している (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E5%8E%9F%E5%9B%A0-6%3A-ttl-%E3%81%AE%E7%AA%93%E3%82%92%E5%A4%96%E3%81%97%E3%81%A6%E3%81%84%E3%82%8B): The author discusses five-minute versus one-hour TTL and zero-output refresh calls. Refreshing the timer without an extra refresh surcharge does not make input/cache-read tokens free. Polling economics depend on cache size, suffix tokens, refresh count and feature compatibility.

Section 確かめ方 ― usage だけが真実 (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#%E7%A2%BA%E3%81%8B%E3%82%81%E6%96%B9-%E2%80%95-usage-%E3%81%A0%E3%81%91%E3%81%8C%E7%9C%9F%E5%AE%9F): Table 2 separates write, read and uncached tokens; adjacent-request diffs and cache diagnostics are recommended. A zero second-call read is not proof that these six causes exhaust all platform, timing and isolation possibilities.

Section CI に入れる (https://zenn.dev/persimmoq/articles/claude-prompt-cache-not-working#ci-%E3%81%AB%E5%85%A5%E3%82%8C%E3%82%8B): A cache-probe command and migration-kit repository are offered. All snippets were read as text; no API call, paid test or article code was run.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A directly relevant Japanese engineering article about Claude prompt-cache diagnostics, not a research paper. Its strongest contribution is an actionable distinction between cache writes and reads and the discovery that first-chunk-only logging cannot test subsequent hits. The author reports one paired API probe and a scan of three personal projects, including two false positives, but no controlled workload benchmark or measured cost reduction. Official documentation corroborates the central cache mechanisms, while frequency ordering, universal tool-set advice and refresh economics remain insufficiently qualified. Useful operational guidance with limited novelty and empirical strength.

primary_link.title: Claude のプロンプトキャッシュが効かない 6 つの原因と、usage で確かめる方法

top5.summary:
This Japanese technical article organizes common causes of Claude prompt-cache misses. Its central lesson is to inspect writes, reads and uncached input separately rather than assuming that cache_control guarantees savings. After examining three personal projects, the author found that a subtitle pipeline logged only its first chunk; its consistently zero read counter therefore could not establish whether later requests hit the cache. A separate paired probe reports cache write/read counts changing from 1123/0 to 0/1123 while uncached input remaining 13.

The article covers variable system prompts, changing tool definitions, length thresholds, breakpoint placement, thinking and effort settings, and expiration. It recommends comparing adjacent requests, inspecting diagnostic fields, and testing whether an identical second request hits the cache. These are primarily explanations of existing mechanisms, not a new caching algorithm.

The evidence is a small set of author observations, without systematic comparisons of cost, latency or hit rate, or data supporting the frequency ordering. Model thresholds and pricing must be checked for the deployed version. Periodic refresh still incurs cache-read and uncached-input charges, and zero-output requests have compatibility limits. Stable tool definitions cannot replace authorization, and request logging requires attention to privacy.
top5.summary_zh:
這篇日文技術文章整理 Claude 提示快取常見的失效來源，重點不是看到 cache_control 就相信已省錢，而是把寫入、讀取與未快取輸入分開觀察。作者檢查三個自用專案，發現一條字幕處理流程只記錄第一個區塊，因此日誌中的讀取量一直為零，不能回答後續請求是否命中。另一次成對探測報告，快取寫入與讀取分別由 1123／0 變成 0／1123，未快取輸入均為 13。

文章依序討論動態系統提示、工具定義變動、長度門檻、斷點位置、思考與努力設定，以及存活時間，並建議比較相鄰請求、查看診斷欄位，將第二次相同請求的命中檢查放入整合測試。這些操作概念主要是既有機制的整理，不是新的快取演算法。

閱讀時要保留界線：這是作者的少量實作觀察，沒有成本、延遲或命中率的系統比較，也沒有資料支持原因的頻率排序。模型門檻與價格須按實際版本核對；定時刷新仍會產生讀取及未快取輸入費用，且零輸出請求有相容性限制。工具集合的穩定性不能取代權限控制，記錄請求內容也應先處理隱私風險。

evidence: Article section 何を解決したかったのか (https://zenn.dev/yutayuki/articles/c65eaaaa0fc427#%E4%BD%95%E3%82%92%E8%A7%A3%E6%B1%BA%E3%81%97%E3%81%9F%E3%81%8B%E3%81%A3%E3%81%9F%E3%81%AE%E3%81%8B): Four concerns are scope, freshness, evidence and operations. Article section あえて実装していないこと (https://zenn.dev/yutayuki/articles/c65eaaaa0fc427#%E3%81%82%E3%81%88%E3%81%A6%E5%AE%9F%E8%A3%85%E3%81%97%E3%81%A6%E3%81%84%E3%81%AA%E3%81%84%E3%81%93%E3%81%A8): The sample is synthetic, uses only in-memory storage, does not connect automatically to ChatGPT or Google Sheets, does not verify evidence truth and cannot detect semantic duplicates. The article expressly says sample test success does not prove long-term answer-quality improvement.

Article section 今後の改善予定 (https://zenn.dev/yutayuki/articles/c65eaaaa0fc427#%E4%BB%8A%E5%BE%8C%E3%81%AE%E6%94%B9%E5%96%84%E4%BA%88%E5%AE%9A): Runtime-state separation, anonymized case studies, more regression failures and quality/time/operational-cost comparisons are future work, not completed results.

llm_evaluation.rationale: A directly relevant Japanese design blog on external memory for long-running ChatGPT workflows. Its useful contribution is to separate project-scoped active retrieval, operational gates and unreviewed experience from later adoption into durable memory. The supplied flow and excerpt, plus independently read repository files, support the limited claim that a small synthetic implementation expresses these boundaries. Static inspection confirms nine test definitions for selected conformance cases; no author code or tests were executed, and their presence is not evidence of measured long-term answer quality. The author explicitly discloses in-memory storage, string-presence rather than truth checking, exact-text rather than semantic deduplication and the absence of an automatic ChatGPT integration. Novelty is chiefly an intelligible engineering arrangement of known lifecycle and provenance principles. The repository describes a private pilot, but auditable task data, controlled outcome comparisons, latency/cost measurements and adversarial robustness are not supplied here. This is an experimental reference architecture, not a validated memory product or a statement about OpenAI’s internal memory implementation. The complete supplied blog and static linked implementation support a bounded review without a material source hold.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這篇日本設計部落格直接對應 ChatGPT 長期工作流程的外部記憶問題。其實用貢獻，是把專案限定的有效記憶取得、必要作業關卡與未審核經驗，和日後正式採用的持久記憶分開。文章流程、輸出節錄及獨立閱讀的儲存庫檔案，支持小型合成實作能表達這些邊界的有限主張。靜態檢查確認九個測試定義涵蓋部分符合性案例；本次未執行作者程式或測試，測試存在也不代表長期回答品質已獲實證。作者明示僅使用記憶體儲存、只檢查根據字串是否存在而非真實性、只能比對正規化相同文字而非語意重複，且沒有自動串接 ChatGPT。新穎性主要在清楚組織既有生命週期與來源追溯原則。儲存庫提到私人試行，但此處未提供可稽核任務資料、受控品質比較、延遲與成本測量或對抗穩健性結果。它是實驗性參考架構，不是已驗證的記憶產品，也不是 OpenAI 內部記憶機制的說明。完整文章和靜態連結實作足以支持有界評估，無實質來源缺件。

primary_link.title: ChatGPTの長期運用で、記憶を増やす前に「保存・取得・採用」を分けてみた

top5.summary: This Japanese design blog separates external memory for long-term ChatGPT use into storage, retrieval and formal adoption. The central idea is not to save more conversation. It is to resolve the project, retrieve required operational rules separately, and then read currently active, relevant memory. New experiences are marked unreviewed and can become formal rules only after a separate evaluation. Start with the flow diagram, then read the minimal Python example and the section on deliberate omissions to distinguish design intent from implemented capability. The public example uses synthetic data and includes nine conformance tests covering project filtering, exclusion of retired records, duplicate writeback and missing gates, among other cases. Static code inspection confirms that these test definitions exist, but no tests were executed in this review, and their existence does not demonstrate improved long-term answer quality. The sample stores data only in memory, checks whether an evidence string is present rather than whether it is true, and cannot recognize semantic duplicates. Project filtering likewise cannot replace authentication and access control. A production system still needs persistence, permissions, auditing, independent verification and failure recovery. The article offers a discussable lifecycle and trust-boundary design; quality, latency, cost and maintenance burden still need controlled comparisons. This is an independent experimental architecture, not an official OpenAI feature or a ready-to-deploy memory product.
top5.summary_zh: 這篇日本設計部落格把長期使用 ChatGPT 的外部記憶問題，拆成保存、取得與正式採用三個環節。核心不是存下更多對話，而是先確定專案、獨立取得必要作業規則，再讀取目前有效且相關的記憶；新經驗先標為未審核，經另外評估後才可能成為正式規則。建議先看流程圖，再讀最小 Python 範例與「刻意未實作」段落，理解設計意圖和實際能力的邊界。公開範例使用合成資料，附九項符合性測試，涵蓋專案篩選、退役紀錄排除、重複寫入與關卡缺漏等情況；靜態程式檢閱可確認這些測試定義存在，但本次沒有執行測試，也不能據此宣稱長期回答品質提升。樣本僅在記憶體中保存資料，只檢查根據字串是否存在，無法判斷真偽，也不能辨識語意重複。專案篩選同樣不能取代身分驗證與存取控制。正式運作的系統仍需持久化、權限、稽核、獨立查證與失敗復原。本文的價值是提供可討論的生命週期與信任邊界；品質、延遲、成本及維護負擔仍待受控比較。這是獨立實驗性架構，並非 OpenAI 官方功能或可直接部署的記憶產品。

evidence: https://qiita.com/TechStudioLab/items/8b8bdf9bbfc3130fbc53 | section top-k=10なら安全、ではない, source characters [303,1050): motivates distinguishing retrieval misses from generation failures with a hypothetical ranked FAQ example; no generated answers are measured.

https://qiita.com/TechStudioLab/items/8b8bdf9bbfc3130fbc53 | section top-kを増やすとrecallとprecisionが逆方向へ動く, [1050,3129): two fixed rankings produce (recall, precision) 0.50/0.50 at k=1, 1.00/0.33 at k=3, and 1.00/0.10 at k=10; independently recomputed offline. These are constructed document-ID metrics, not benchmark outcomes.

https://qiita.com/TechStudioLab/items/8b8bdf9bbfc3130fbc53 | section 固定top-kからscore thresholdへ変える, [3129,4933): thresholds 0.0, 0.5, and 0.8 retain five, three, and one fixed hits; the article explicitly rejects a universally correct threshold.

https://qiita.com/TechStudioLab/items/8b8bdf9bbfc3130fbc53 | section thresholdにも正解はない, [4933,6002): discusses multi-document coverage, score distribution changes, and independent retrieval/answer evaluation; no deployed-system evaluation or uncertainty interval is supplied.

https://qiita.com/TechStudioLab/items/8b8bdf9bbfc3130fbc53 | two directly inspected inline images: conceptual library/document-selection illustrations with no plotted measurements, numerical tables, or experimental results.

OpenAI primary documentation checked on 2026-10-08: Retrieval, Ranking and search-count sections support score_threshold in [0,1], the risk of excluding useful chunks, and max_num_results up to 50; the CLI search reference confirms [1,50]. Evaluation best practices, Q&A over docs, separates context recall/precision and answer quality. This corroborates API features and evaluation framing, not the blog's causal headline. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/retrieval ; https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/cli/resources/vector_stores/methods/search ; https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/evaluation-best-practices .
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to RAG evaluation and practical LLM engineering, but this is a technical blog explainer, not a peer-reviewed research paper or a new retrieval method. Two hand-constructed FAQ rankings reproduce the stated recall/precision arithmetic, and the threshold example is transparent; both article images are conceptual illustrations. There is no real retriever, generated-answer experiment, baseline study, ablation, uncertainty estimate, or released benchmark demonstrating that increasing top-k worsens answer accuracy. Recall cannot decrease for nested result sets, whereas precision can rise or fall; the illustrated decrease is not a universal law, and thresholding does not guarantee higher relevance. The useful contribution is an accessible separation of retrieval and generation evaluation, with chunk/file labeling and distribution-shift caveats. Novelty, rigor, and evidence are therefore low despite practical relevance and reproducible toy calculations.

The useful contribution is an accessible separation of retrieval and generation evaluation, with chunk/file labeling and distribution-shift caveats. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文與 RAG 評估及大型語言模型工程高度相關，但屬技術部落格解說，並非同儕審查研究，也未提出新檢索方法。兩組人工設計的常見問題排序可重現文中的召回率與精確率運算，門檻範例亦清楚；兩張圖片皆為概念插圖。文中沒有真實檢索器、生成答案實驗、基準比較、消融、誤差估計或公開評測集，無法實證增加 top-k 會降低答案正確率。對巢狀結果集合，召回率不會下降，但精確率可能升降；範例中的下降並非普遍定律，分數門檻亦不保證相關性提升。其價值在於易懂地區分檢索與生成評估，並提醒文件與區塊標記及分布改變的限制。因此，雖然實務相關性及玩具運算可重現性不錯，新穎性、嚴謹性與證據強度仍低。

primary_link.title: LLMのRAGでtop-kを増やすと回答が悪化する理由

top5.summary: This technical explainer discusses a common RAG tuning pitfall: retrieving more items may recover necessary documents while also passing irrelevant material to the language model. The author computes document-level recall and precision for two manually specified FAQ rankings; the example first recovers a missed answer document and then adds only noise. Another code example combines a result-count limit with a score threshold, noting that a high threshold may remove necessary evidence. In practice, hold chunking and ranking settings fixed and use the same labeled questions to track retrieved documents, retrieval metrics, and final answer quality separately. For questions requiring multiple documents, label the complete evidence set and keep adding cases representative of real traffic. Crucially, the article runs neither a real retrieval model nor answer generation, and provides no experiments comparing models, corpora, or thresholds; its two images are conceptual illustrations. It therefore offers reproducible teaching calculations, not proof that increasing result count necessarily reduces answer accuracy. Precision can rise or fall with the relevance of added documents, and scores do not guarantee correctness. Use it to establish diagnostics and small tests, not as a new research result or universal parameter prescription.
top5.summary_zh: 這篇技術解說討論 RAG 常見的調整陷阱：增加檢索件數雖可能補回必要文件，也可能把更多無關內容交給語言模型。作者以兩組手工設定的常見問題排序，分別計算文件層級召回率與精確率；增加件數後，範例先找回漏掉的答案文件，之後只增加雜訊。另一段程式示範結合件數上限與分數門檻，並提醒高門檻也可能排除必要證據。實作上，應固定切塊與排序設定，使用同一組有標記的問題，分別追蹤取得文件、檢索指標與最終答案品質；多文件問題則需標出完整證據集合，並持續加入接近真實流量的案例。重要限制是：本文沒有真正執行檢索模型或生成答案，也沒有比較不同模型、語料或門檻的實驗，兩張圖只是概念插畫。因此，它展示的是可重現的教學運算，不能證明增加件數必然降低答案正確率。精確率可能隨新增文件的相關性而上升或下降，分數也不是正確性的保證。適合拿來建立診斷流程與小型測試，不宜當作新研究成果或通用參數設定。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope Japanese introductory explainer about LLM hallucinations and safer application design. It clearly distinguishes generation from external retrieval, warns that prompting and RAG do not eliminate errors, and recommends citations, output validation and evaluation before consequential use. These are useful educational messages, not a new method or an empirical result. All fourteen text examples and flows are illustrative; there are no measured models, datasets, baselines, error rates or mitigation comparisons. The next-token account is a simplified explanation, not a complete causal theory of hallucination or proof about model knowledge and intent. Output-shape constraints should not be read as factual verification, and the article does not evaluate citation correctness, retrieval recall or validator failure. An external primary-source cross-check supports the broader role of training/evaluation incentives and uncertainty beyond the article’s brief account, but that additional evidence is not credited as the blog’s own research. Its single embedded card is a company homepage, not a technical reference. The supplied article is complete enough to review; lack of research evidence is not a missing-source hold.

top5.summary: This Japanese introduction uses hypothetical examples involving a nonexistent JavaScript method, features attributed to a future year and company policies to explain how language models can produce fluent but false answers. Its key distinction is between generation, obtaining supporting information and verification. Asking a model not to guess is only one step; applications also need appropriate context, checkable sources and output validation. The article illustrates RAG as retrieving relevant documents before providing their contents to the model, while warning that retrieval may miss information, return incorrect sources or be misinterpreted. RAG therefore cannot guarantee the elimination of hallucinations. Flows that execute generated SQL directly or make payments immediately after a model determines an amount illustrate the danger of acting without verification. Read these examples before the six countermeasures and seven-point recap, and relate the principles to failure cases in your own application. All fourteen text examples are illustrative rather than experimental records. The article provides no model comparisons, dataset, error rates or effectiveness evaluation. Next-token prediction is only a simplified mechanism explanation: training and evaluation incentives, uncertainty and abstention also affect errors. Constraining output format is likewise not factual verification. The article is useful for understanding layered validation, but deployment still requires separate evaluation of whether citations support answers, whether retrieval is complete and when validators themselves fail.
top5.summary_zh: 這篇日本入門文章以不存在的 JavaScript 方法、未來年份功能及公司規章等假想例子，說明語言模型為何可能產生流暢卻不符合事實的回答。閱讀重點是把生成、取得根據與驗證分開：提示模型不要猜測只是其中一步，還要提供合適的背景資料、讓使用者能核對出處，並在應用程式端檢查輸出。文章以 RAG 展示先搜尋相關文件、再把內容交給模型回答的流程，同時提醒搜尋可能漏掉資料、找到錯誤來源，或被模型誤解，因此不能保證消除幻覺。生成 SQL 後直接執行、讓模型判定金額後直接付款，則是文中用來警示未經驗證就採取行動的流程。建議先讀這些例子，再看六項對策與七點摘要，將原則對應到自己的失敗案例。需要注意，十四個文字例子都不是實驗紀錄，本文沒有模型比較、資料集、錯誤率或措施效果評估。下一個詞元預測只是簡化機制說明，訓練與評估誘因、不確定性及選擇不作答也影響錯誤；限制輸出格式亦不等於查證事實。本文適合建立分層驗證的基本觀念，但實際部署仍須另外評估引用是否支持回答、檢索是否完整，以及驗證器本身何時失效。
